In an era dominated by corporate media conglomerates, the platform X (formerly Twitter) has emerged as a bastion for citizen journalism, empowering ordinary individuals to bypass traditional gatekeepers and expose stories that might otherwise remain buried. Were it not for these grassroots reporters--armed with smartphones, social media accounts, and a commitment to transparency--we would likely remain ignorant of several pressing issues: black-on-white crime, censorship in Europe, institutionalized anti-white racism, 2020 election fraud, the rapid growth of Muslim mosques in Texas, and corruption scandals in Minnesota.

X's open forum has democratized information, revealing systemic biases in mainstream outlets that prioritize narratives over facts. Through specific examples drawn from X posts and related reports, it becomes clear that citizen journalists fill a critical void, often at personal risk, to inform the public.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.r51yaYZHfyMa-e_nEqxiHsD53gq8c19DaIB5AJfzMX8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=188374115)
Consider black-on-white crime, a topic frequently downplayed or ignored by legacy media. Citizen journalists on X have repeatedly highlighted incidents and patterns that national networks avoid, fearing accusations of racial insensitivity.

For instance, in a July 2025 post, user @WanjiruNjoya noted a "[complete media blackout on reporting crimes by black people](https://substack.com/redirect/8dc05b0e-b9c0-4319-9686-8f7c7799fe07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," emphasizing that without X, many wouldn't grasp the issue's severity.

Similarly, @JohnLeFevre's December 2025 [video post](https://substack.com/redirect/80113190-6c04-4bd5-8f82-2660abf9c2d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explicitly credits citizen journalists on X for bringing attention to "rampant black-on-white crime," sharing footage that went viral despite minimal cable news coverage.

Web reports underscore this: a [Nature article from December 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/ab57bc99-0526-4bdb-9878-ec67fc662c35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) describes X as a "decentralized newsroom" where citizens expose underreported stories, including racial crime dynamics.

Without X, these accounts might never surface, leaving the public reliant on sanitized statistics from outlets like CNN or The New York Times, which often frame such crimes as isolated rather than patterned.

Censorship in Europe represents another arena where X has been instrumental. European governments, under the guise of combating "disinformation," have imposed draconian measures, but citizen journalists on X have amplified resistance.

A [July 2025 post](https://substack.com/redirect/e1d694b2-3a7c-4b7e-b78d-aecec3fae049?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by @SocialistMMA detailed an "INSANE censorship law" in the EU making it illegal to question official narratives, warning that "Europe is completely cooked."

This echoed broader discussions, like @MarioNawfal's [December 2025 thread](https://substack.com/redirect/f2c5b431-65a4-43ce-9621-8ad91a2d3951?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) celebrating X as Europe's top news source despite EU threats of bans and fines for non-compliance.

Web analyses, such as a [Liverpool University piece from December 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/c8127ae0-4483-40a4-82be-29d202d20147?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), explain how the EU fined X €120 million not for content but for transparency lapses, yet users on the platform framed it as a free speech assault.

A Euronews [report from December 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/b2bbb131-9059-42bd-91d4-8e227bd94e9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) even noted U.S. visa bans on EU officials like Thierry Breton for alleged censorship pushes.

Mainstream European media, often state-funded, rarely critiques these policies deeply; X's real-time discourse has forced global awareness, preventing total narrative control.

Institutionalized anti-white racism, often dismissed as fringe rhetoric, has been spotlighted by X users who document biases in education, media, and policy. A [December 2025 post](https://substack.com/redirect/0d675ee9-b0a3-46bd-a5bf-b0605762d0fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by @Jim_0_Hara compiled examples from movies, articles, and institutions, arguing that "anti-white discrimination is completely institutionalized" and unimaginable for other races.

@JohnLeFevre again linked it to X's role in exposure, tying it to broader suppressed stories.

Ironically, outlets like The Atlantic in November 2024 labeled X a "[white-supremacist site](https://substack.com/redirect/1fdf2a53-b310-4801-ab48-222dc3a2177b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," yet this critique itself highlights how the platform allows counter-narratives to flourish.

Web sources, including a CNBC [report from 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/5bd1a456-6da4-4a2c-a4b8-f8943a31c7e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), reference Elon Musk's accusations of media racism against whites and Asians, amplified on X.

Without citizen journalists sharing evidence of discriminatory policies--like DEI initiatives excluding whites--public discourse would be dominated by progressive echo chambers, obscuring reverse discrimination.

The 2020 election fraud allegations, debunked by courts but persistently debated, owe much of their visibility to X. Citizen journalists have unearthed and disseminated claims of irregularities that legacy media dismissed outright.

A June 2025 video post by @Juliesnark1731 presented "[PROOF](https://substack.com/redirect/b9ab3087-ae02-4113-bbff-0b68583055e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" of fraud involving China, Serbia, and Dominion systems, garnering millions of views.
@laralogan's [October 2024 thread](https://substack.com/redirect/0a9e753f-9c08-4352-a1e7-daaebe8535a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) praised investigators tracking fraud in real time, urging shares to "overwhelm the cheat."

Recent posts, like @XFreeze's [December 2025 assertion](https://substack.com/redirect/811fe81b-f3d5-41cb-ab5b-3469327f51ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "citizen journalism has exposed what legacy media buried," tie it to ongoing fraud narratives.

Web fact-checks from BBC and CBS in 2024 note how X amplified voter fraud claims, often from anonymous users, forcing responses from officials.

Absent X, these stories might fade into obscurity, as mainstream outlets like AP labeled them baseless without exploring grassroots evidence.

The growth of Muslim mosques in Texas, often tied to immigration and funding concerns, has been chronicled by X users amid sparse traditional coverage.

@JohnnyWhiskyTX's [December 2025 post](https://substack.com/redirect/c9baa6b6-5fcd-4f92-90b6-0373e4c413f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) warned of "Islamic expansion" with 400 mosques, 392 built monthly, and $13 million in taxpayer grants from Governor Abbott.

An August 2025 thread by the same user depicted Texas as a "jihad hub," sharing visuals of mosque proliferation.

Web reports, like a Texas Tribune [piece from March 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/3671be98-3a29-4df2-8ee3-e3d44e98eebd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), detail investigations into projects like the East Plano Islamic Center amid anti-Muslim backlash.

NPR's May 2025 coverage noted DOJ probes into discrimination against such developments.

Citizen posts on X have driven scrutiny, revealing demographic shifts that local media underreports to avoid controversy.

Finally, corruption in Minnesota, particularly in social programs, has been laid bare by X-based exposes. Nick Shirley's viral December 2025 video uncovered billions in fraud via empty daycares receiving millions, prompting calls for accountability.

@annbauerwriter's [October 2025 post](https://substack.com/redirect/abb30fe8-0435-4a0f-8787-144424656160?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) described DFL money laundering through programs, crediting X for connections.

Web stories from [Economic Times](https://substack.com/redirect/dcdd3f77-0e48-4e73-8add-dc392d3a26a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Daily Mail](https://substack.com/redirect/486fe192-ae27-4218-a644-c5a9c04cbe59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in December 2025 highlight Shirley's role, noting over $1 billion lost since 2018.

Without X, these scandals might evade national attention, as local media often aligns with Democratic interests.

Citizen journalists on X have revolutionized accountability, shining light on issues mainstream media ignores due to ideological or financial pressures. From racial crimes to political fraud, their efforts ensure diverse voices challenge the status quo. As @GrageDustin noted in [May 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/82176ff1-24cf-4a76-80a9-39838e734d0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), X makes stories "impossible to ignore."

Preserving this platform is essential for democracy--without it, truth risks being censored into oblivion.

_Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sole opinion of the writer._

For more on great work by citizen journalist @HoneyBaderMom C.K. Bouferrache on Portland Antifa see our podcast [Episode 404](https://substack.com/redirect/81902ed5-68ca-4a2f-8bdb-97829e9e2693?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Texas based independent journalist Hernando Arce [Ep 264](https://substack.com/redirect/4e748904-3e3d-4577-ada7-19fa48272adf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and many more at our [Heartland Journal Channel](https://substack.com/redirect/de8ce179-edeb-4262-8522-9fbbeabaee6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I’m teaming up with AOC to fix child care
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Add your name if you want affordable childcare in every community

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2782%2E4032634%2E_IL80b)
---
I’ve been talking about the child care crisis for years. Unaffordable child care almost kept me from pursuing my education and my career. I ran for president on this issue. I’ve introduced bill after bill to bring costs down. I’ve sat with parents and heard how they’re juggling bills, rearranging shifts, and still barely making it work. And since then, the crisis hasn’t stopped. It’s deepened. But we’re still in this fight, and I’m continuing to address this critical issue alongside Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez with her leading my **Child Care for Every Community Act** in the House — and we’re advocating for the Democratic party to prioritize reducing child care costs ahead of this year’s midterms. [**I’ll share more below about our bill. And if you agree that Democrats must, must, must champion child care affordability in 2026, please add your name to sign on to this plan.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-childcareact/?source=EMZ29S_CHI_E_20260218_V1S1&t=8&akid=2782%2E4032634%2E_IL80b) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-childcareact/?source=EMZ29S_CHI_E_20260218_V1S1&t=9&akid=2782%2E4032634%2E_IL80b)
---
During his reelection campaign, Donald Trump dismissed child care costs as “relatively speaking, not very expensive.”
_**Relatively speaking?**_
Tell that to the parents paying thousands — sometimes tens of thousands — every year for care. Tell that to the mom who left her career because her entire paycheck went to daycare. Tell that to the grandparents draining their retirement trying to help out.
Here's what Trump won't say: Child care costs are crushing American families. And that’s a policy failure, not a personal one.
For decades, Washington has treated child care as a private problem that families should simply “figure out.” Heck, on the campaign trail JD Vance said one of the ways to help parents struggling with daycare costs was _“Maybe, grandma and grandpa wants to help out a little bit more. Or maybe there’s an aunt or uncle that wants to help out a little bit more.”_
Meanwhile, costs have skyrocketed, child care workers are paid poverty wages, and parents are left scrambling.
In the wealthiest nation on Earth, we've simply decided that affordable, high-quality child care is a luxury for the rich. We can’t keep going like this. Here’s what our bill will do:
* Ensure that **half of families pay no more than $10 a day** for child care
* **Cap costs for most other families** on a sliding scale based on income
* Give our nation’s child care workers **a raise**

And here’s the thing: We already know a system like this works.
The U.S. military already provides affordable, accessible child care for service members through a sliding-scale program based on income. It demonstrates that with political will, we can make child care affordable and reliable.
What’s more? This isn’t theoretical — it's already happening.
New Mexico was the first state in the nation to offer no-cost universal child care for families, regardless of income.
In New York City, universal 3-K and Pre-K programs have expanded access to free early childhood education for tens of thousands of families.
And in San Francisco, voters approved a dedicated public funding stream to make child care more affordable and increase wages for providers.
These communities are reminding us that childhood should be a promise in America — not a privilege.
[**Add your name if you believe it’s time to make affordable child care available in every community.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-childcareact/?source=EMZ29S_CHI_E_20260219_V1S1&t=10&akid=2782%2E4032634%2E_IL80b)
[**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-childcareact/?source=EMZ29S_CHI_E_20260218_V1S1&t=11&akid=2782%2E4032634%2E_IL80b)
---
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

## **Volunteer Spotlight**
In future editions, I will use this section to shine a ight on a volunteer. This month, I'm going to tell you a little about myself.
I made the move to Somerset County from Allegheny County in the spring of 2023. My husband and I chose Somerset because of our shared love for the outdoors, particularly skiing. We had maintained a second home here for many years and decided to relocate permanently once our children were grown. I now spend most of my free time outdoors, hiking, skiing, and enjoying the beauty of the Laurel Highlands. Professionally, I work as a paralegal, mostly from home.
My commitment to the Harris/Walz campaign quickly led me to join the Somerset County Democratic Committee, where I currently serve as secretary. I first met Alan Bradstock in July when he announced his candidacy at one of our committee meetings. In September, Alan invited me to join his campaign to help coordinate volunteers and events.
A unique aspect of this campaign is the incredible dedication and talent of our volunteers; you are the driving force behind everything we do. Our team has grown significantly since our first volunteer event at the Croatian Club in October, now including hundreds of committed individuals! While flipping the 14th District is a primary objective, building a strong community is an equally important goal, and watching this group come together has been profoundly fulfilling.
Getting to know you, our amazing and dedicated volunteers is, without a doubt, my favorite part of this job. I especially enjoy talking to you one-on-one either in person or by telephone and discussing your ideas and insights. Please do not hesitate to contact me by call, text, or email.
Best,
Kate Rullo

name: Fran Hong
subject: It’s time to apply pressure
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
Sign the petition to pause AI data centers and cap rates
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260218-2531)
Peter,
My name is Samantha Doucas, and I've been on the front lines of the fight against unchecked AI data center expansion, from Kenosha to Janesville and everywhere in between.
Some of the biggest tech companies in the world are racing to build massive data centers that consume more energy than entire cities — and regular people will pay for it through higher utility bills. At a time when one in four American households already can't afford their energy costs, this is literally a reverse Robin Hood scenario: taking from the poor and giving to the rich.
We have a real chance to get ahead of this issue, but we need to put pressure on lawmakers now.
**That's why I'm asking you to[sign this petition](https://act.francescahong.com/go/4888?t=1&akid=2531%2E105371%2EbBgRDO) from Citizen Action of Wisconsin urging your legislators to co-sponsor two critical bills:**
**The Data Center Pause Bill** (LRB-6377/LRB-6391) would prevent consumers from paying increased utility costs driven by data center energy demand, require 100% new renewable energy for these facilities, impose strong environmental safeguards, and ensure the work is done by well-paid union workers.
**The Utility Rate Cap Bill**(AB 785/SB 780) would cap electricity and heating costs at an affordable percentage of household income — so no one has to choose between keeping the lights on and putting food on the table.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260218.xhltVd&amount=5&refcode=em20260218-2531&t=17&akid=2531%2E105371%2EbBgRDO)**
[Or donate another amount ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260218.xhltVd&refcode=em20260218-2531&t=18&akid=2531%2E105371%2EbBgRDO)
Wisconsin already gives data centers $40 million a year in sales and use tax exemptions — way more than legislators predicted when they passed those breaks in 2023. And what do we get for it? Look at what other states are learning the hard way: Illinois lost $370 million in tax revenue through data center exemptions. One data center there got $38 million in tax breaks and created 20 jobs. Virginia audited their program and found a negative 52% return on investment — they spent $930 million in exemptions and got less than half back.
Sound familiar? It's Foxconn 2.0: When Governor Walker handed out nearly $1 billion in subsidies for a promised $10 billion investment and 13,000 jobs, they pulled the rug and Wisconsin taxpayers were left holding the bag.
We can't let this happen again.
This fight is winnable, but only if we have leaders who are willing to stand with us. Fran has been one of those leaders since day one. She's the strongest candidate on AI data center regulation, she's been involved with many of the bills at the center of this fight, and her platform puts affordability and working families first — from energy costs to health care to universal child care. She’s the real deal.
**[If you want to support the kind of leadership that actually shows up on these issues, chip in to Fran's campaign today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260218.xhltVd&refcode=em20260218-2531&t=19&akid=2531%2E105371%2EbBgRDO)**
Thank you for standing with us,
Samamtha Doucas
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260218-2531&t=20&refcode2=2531_105371_bBgRDO&akid=2531%2E105371%2EbBgRDO)**

The more people who engage with our emails, the more likely we’ll go straight to your inbox. For a free and easy way to help our campaign, please [click this link to our website](https://francescahong.com/) after you finish reading our emails.

name: Tobias Read
subject: Don’t sit on the sidelines
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260218em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260218em]
There’s an old truth about politics that feels especially urgent right now: progress is never made by the loudest critics on the sidelines. It’s made by the people who show up, take risks, and do the hard, unglamorous work — even when they know they’ll be attacked for it.
Across Oregon, that work is happening every day. Local leaders keep communities running. Neighbors standing up for one another. People pushing back against fear, misinformation, and division — not with outrage alone, but with action.
But action takes resources.
If we want to defend our values, protect our communities, and strengthen our democracy from the ground up, we can’t just comment, post, or shake our heads. We have to invest in organization, accountability, and leaders willing to step into the arena and take responsibility.
That’s why I’m asking for your support today.
Your contribution helps ensure Oregon continues to have leaders who are willing to do the work, speak the truth, and stand up when it matters — not just criticize from the sidelines. Mayors, city councilors, county commissioners, as well as activists and advocates for democracy...we need to support these leaders at all levels. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260218em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260218em]
The challenges we face won’t be solved overnight. But they will be shaped by who shows up.
I hope you’ll join me.
Thank you,
Tobias Read

Friend, I remember learning about fascism in school and thinking, "What would I do in 1930s Germany?" With ICE terrorizing our communities and the House passing the SAVE Act, I don't have to wonder anymore. **The SAVE Act is this administration's latest and most blatant attempt to rig future elections by requiring people to show documents like a passport or birth certificate to register to vote and a photo ID to cast a ballot.** It gets worse: the SAVE Act also includes a directive that states must regularly submit their voter rolls to the Department of Homeland Security. The same Department of Homeland Security run by Kristi Noem that has overseen ICE and repeatedly detained, and even killed, U.S. citizens. It's easy to hear about legislation and think "That's just another acronym for a bad bill," or "Yeah I get it – if Republicans introduce it, I'm against it." This is true, but it doesn't end there. It's fascism, plain and simple. It's just another type of fascism: "moderate" Republicans use the systems Democrats praise to undermine our society. **In Congress, I'll fight tooth and nail to counter this administration. That's how we fight the more "quiet" forms of fascism.** [**Friend, if this is the type of Democrat you want, please chip in $1 or more today.**](https://ka4il.us/l/gBtGRQBa7gH6)

**_Fascism is, and has always been, their end goal._**
Their vision is one of a militarized country where only certain people—a few dozen rich men—have a seat at the table, and dissidents like me are silenced.
Trump and Elon know that progressive movements like ours are in the way because I've made it abundantly clear that strongly worded letters, wearing matching outfits while holding up signs, and meaningless acts of symbolism **aren't my thing.**

Fellow American, I wanted you to be one of the first to know.

I am officially running for re-election to the United States Senate.

It is my greatest honor to serve the people of Montana. From cutting taxes and securing our border, to protecting our Second Amendment and standing up against government overreach, my priority has always been to put Montana first.

But now that I am officially in, **_the Left will stop at nothing to attack me_.**

clean_body: I have officially filed to run for re-election. I am in, but I need to know, are you in with me? | Fellow American, I wanted you to be one of the first to know. I am officially running for re-election to the United States Senate. It is my greatest honor to serve the people of Montana. From cutting taxes and securing our border, to protecting our Second Amendment and standing up against government overreach, my priority has always been to put Montana first. But now that I am officially in, the Left will stop at nothing to attack me. I spent all of 2024 leading the fight to retake the Senate Majority, ending the Democrats' four catastrophic years in the Majority. This made Chuck Schumer and Senate Democrats MAD. If we're going to hold our Senate majority, we need to keep this Montana seat RED this November. Jon Tester and Chuck Schumer are going all in to defeat me in 2026, recruiting a liberal (running as an "independent") to run against me. Fellow American, I have a personal ask. Your founding support today will give my team the resources they need to plan and execute what will be one of the most expensive Senate races in the Country. We only won back the Senate majority thanks to the support of grassroots donors like you. Your foundational support today will be the reason we keep Montana Red and defend our conservative majority in the Senate. Thanks, Steve Daines Steve Daines is a fifth-generation Montanan, life-long sportsman and father of four serving the people of Montana as their Senator. Steve is committed to always putting Montana first as he works to bring real change to Washington and fights for more jobs, less government and common sense solutions to get our country back on track. Senator Steve Daines | | Paid for by Steve Daines for Montana

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts. By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks. She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history. Nancy is fighting to: Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started. | | | | | | | | Paid for by Nancy Mace For Governor | | Copyright © 2025 , All rights reserved.

Hi Derek, Governor Tony Evers here.

Last night, I delivered my eighth and final State of the State address.

I'm proud of what we've accomplished together — fixing over 9,600 miles of roads, cutting middle-class taxes by 23 percent, investing $360 million in child care, and signing more than 800 bipartisan bills. After 50 years in public service, I can say Wisconsin is stronger than when I started.

All the progress and strength that we've built is at risk if Tom Tiffany is elected governor.

[**That is why I am asking for your support, before I explain why can you click here and donate $7 so that my Governor Readiness program has the support it needs to stop Tom Tiffany and elect a Democrat in November?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsfsLn2kpmIbid-V-qD1qwGK7pgh6GxFFA8M4d2w8kuf-MCjWm6tKyyfn6ti12LR65PFrcnQVRN8b80GoGyk-imDiEHvxAaqcfSQIQViakloWIASAKlsA4estGwqTxSX0qwDmwDnqdwp9-jnQC1SjsMwI9Hy8SQGc8FR-yXBq-BYmC0ZQa4UQ-0G8wWNc6A8vHySQUJKhcWTqLpogQDXZNNm4bUqOzhfS8e_9kvQorXVjZEmxtVp7AhlXouQGSLPBEHv3pl6LDmjYJ_tw6RuBUGywxPB9bQp6ZjyguzqqlclIsWVwcvUnTJQZBITnE3ORHzgbA9tH8lNh6SdHgXDtNz/4oa/Gn4QbPhzRcq3wKjbouMqMA/h1/h001.bbbRbqloK0lt_Ug4Xn5qzMo2GRchpxYatxN5AnZFAno)

clean_body: Thank you, and On, Wisconsin! | | | Hi Derek, Governor Tony Evers here. Last night, I delivered my eighth and final State of the State address. I'm proud of what we've accomplished together — fixing over 9,600 miles of roads, cutting middle-class taxes by 23 percent, investing $360 million in child care, and signing more than 800 bipartisan bills. After 50 years in public service, I can say Wisconsin is stronger than when I started. All the progress and strength that we've built is at risk if Tom Tiffany is elected governor. Over 270,000 Wisconsinites are about to lose their healthcare. Tariffs are driving up the cost of groceries and gas. And Donald Trump has already endorsed Tom Tiffany to be my successor, which means Tiffany will be all in to support Trump's chaos. Once our Democratic nominee wins the primary on August 11th, we'll have just 84 days until the general election. Republicans are already pouring millions into the race for governor and we can't afford to wait. If you've saved your payment info with ActBlue, your contribution will be processed immediately. I declared 2026 the Year of the Neighbor — because when things get tough, Wisconsinites roll up their sleeves and show up for each other. That's how we've always won: not with billionaire donors, but with real people chipping in what they can. Whether it's protecting our fair maps, defending reproductive rights, funding our schools, or fighting back against federal overreach — we need a governor who will keep putting Wisconsin families first. Your support today helps make sure our nominee has everything they need to win on day one of the general election. Thanks for being in this fight with me. I’m Kristin. I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 21st Congressional District, but I’m not your typical politician.

I’m a working-class Democrat, a scientist with a PhD in animal behavior, and a former middle school teacher (so yes, I’m very well prepared to handle Congress!) [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125664864/602562310/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_NF_reintroduction_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTk3ZDBjN2UtM2EwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VwgKZtsnEZJYGEC5FbC6MFEm51qcpaJzFrlYmhdvsyI=) _Spending time with mi familia in South Texas_ Working families like yours need a champion – someone who will fight to lower your costs, demand accountability from our leaders, and expand opportunities for Texans. That’s me.

I was raised in South Texas by a single mom who never went to college. We lived paycheck to paycheck. I was taught that hard work pays off, and I started working at the age of 14. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125664865/602562311/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_NF_reintroduction_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTk3ZDBjN2UtM2EwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VwgKZtsnEZJYGEC5FbC6MFEm51qcpaJzFrlYmhdvsyI=) _A moment with my mom, my biggest supporter_ But today, far too many families are doing everything right and still can’t afford housing, healthcare, groceries, or childcare. They can’t afford the American dream they were promised – and deserve.

That’s not a personal failure. That’s a policy failure. And it’s why I know I can make a difference in Congress.

Before running for office, I served as a scientist in the federal government. I protected taxpayer dollars at the U.S. Government Accountability Office, and I expanded healthcare access at the National Institutes of Health. In the U.S. Senate, I helped hold the first Trump administration and corporate CEOs accountable, securing over $20 billion in environmental justice provisions into federal law. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125664866/602562312/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_NF_reintroduction_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTk3ZDBjN2UtM2EwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VwgKZtsnEZJYGEC5FbC6MFEm51qcpaJzFrlYmhdvsyI=) | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125664867/602562313/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_NF_reintroduction_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTk3ZDBjN2UtM2EwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VwgKZtsnEZJYGEC5FbC6MFEm51qcpaJzFrlYmhdvsyI=)
---|---
_Working in the lab as a scientist and showing up for climate accountability_
I know how to make government work for people.

And I believe government can – and should – be a powerful force for good, not a weapon of oppression. That’s why I’m running for Congress.

Our campaign is about building an economy that works for everyone, fixing our broken healthcare system, funding public schools so every child can thrive, and holding powerful interests accountable.

If elected, I would make history as the first woman and Latina to represent TX-21 and the first woman with a STEM PhD to ever serve in Congress.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125664868/602562314/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_NF_reintroduction_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTk3ZDBjN2UtM2EwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VwgKZtsnEZJYGEC5FbC6MFEm51qcpaJzFrlYmhdvsyI=)
_I was the first in my family to graduate with a PhD_
**But this campaign isn’t about the past. It’s about the future.**

I’m so grateful you’re here. This campaign is a grassroots movement built by people who believe we deserve better and who are ready to fight for it.

With you beside me, I know we can build something better. Let’s get to work.

With Gratitude,
Kristin

Today, my running mate, Rob Krop, and I went down in person to witness the outrageous sewage spillage that is happening as we speak. This is not just a problem for DC and Virginia. Governor Moore has a duty to utilize his emergency powers to ensure that every Marylander is safe and protected from disasters like this.

This could have been prevented and it is a lack of basic leadership that has caused our fellow Marylanders to suffer. The incompetent and apathetic leadership of this administration must be held accountable. Governor Moore claimed just recently that the Potomac spillage is "nearly contained." Folks, as I saw with my own eyes, the sewage is pouring out into the canal and Marylanders are still telling me they are without drinking water. They can't cook with it and they even have to "use water bottles to make tea...no one is listening to us," one Marylander wrote me.

I am calling on Governor Moore to take immediate action in implementing the full power of his emergency department to help Marylanders NOW. Please stand with me by donating today so that, on day one of my administration, I can stand for you. No Marylander should ever have to say, "No one is listening to us."

Thank you for your support in this campaign. It's time to take our voice to the Governor's mansion and clean house.

name: Rory Hoskins
subject: When ICE stormed a cemetery, I fought back.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Colorado Draws the Line
body:
| | | | | [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018oRUpH7gRz3ye3XdfDb28C8VSX2fWGOD4da8oJFUG97ujfH3itIFcU771YjoM8AnhEvz4474KyycSwprIPFOfmfl94wfCTXRJj3bfFJIf2KMz9J8mLIE8txG6hc-G7aWkI8WmIWeDho7AQ0_WAclqvbHjVg8XoGQVHAFCcblPUP5bzTOObJFrDGHBFfpq4fJd6wYNV1692ueLyLDrpSusX92tWZI8Te3yXxtklqLcIKK95qo3WFeNg==&c=0H5FOk00x8yveu6_82C-BPh4dbAuwAOYy3DcsdW3SrLzYNHwlQ30kw==&ch=vCxviQua00brcmE1JJr196wSBZ_37c0aLFtLmD6NXicLxFwyN4CHYw==)
---
Peter,
I want to tell you a story that says more about why I am running for Congress than any slogan or talking point ever could.
Earlier this year, in the middle of the afternoon, ICE agents stormed Concordia Cemetery in Forest Park, where I'm proud to serve as Mayor. The workers on site had just tried to help a man who was struggling in the river. They were doing their jobs. They were watching out for human life. They were on private property.
Then ICE showed up.
Agents cut the lock off the cemetery gate. They pushed their way inside. They fired pepper balls and pepper spray at the workers. They slammed men to the ground. They zip-tied four of them and hauled them away for questioning. And every single one of those workers was a United States citizen.
Let me pause on that. These were working people. Groundskeepers. Fathers. Neighbors. They were not suspects. They were not fugitives. They were not even the individuals ICE claimed to be looking for. They were simply in the way.
The agents held them for hours. No charges. No explanation. No respect for due process, private property, or basic constitutional rights.
I stood with those workers the next day. I listened as they described what it felt like to be thrown to the ground in a place families consider sacred. I heard how agents tried to intimidate them. I saw the bruises. And I made one thing very clear.
What happened in that cemetery was unlawful, unconstitutional, and unacceptable.
My job as mayor is to protect the people of Forest Park. My job as a lawyer is to stand up for the Constitution. My job as a human being is to defend dignity wherever it is under attack. So I called on ICE leadership to explain why their agents behaved like an unaccountable militia. I demanded answers. I brought attention to the workers' story. I made sure they had support and legal assistance. And I refused to let anyone in Washington pretend this was normal.
Because it was not normal. It was lawless federal power unleashed without discipline or respect. And for too long, too many politicians in Congress have looked the other way.
I am running for Congress because this cannot continue. If federal agents can break into a cemetery in broad daylight and assault four innocent workers without consequences, then we have lost something fundamental. We have lost the principle that no one is above the law. We have lost the idea that government power must be accountable to the people. We have lost the basic promise that the Constitution protects every single one of us.
I am not willing to lose that.
[If you believe we need members of Congress who will enforce the Constitution against abuses of power, I am asking you to stand with me. Split a contribution between my campaign and Colorado Draws the Line to help us take this fight to the halls of Congress. $10, $25, or even $50 would make such a massive difference to this team.](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018oRUpH7gRz3ye3XdfDb28C8VSX2fWGOD4da8oJFUG97ujfH3itIFcU771YjoM8AnUIYFNfovSWSeQQ0YloLEoFwjNC_Aupat-IV3hxeNwBE-CrRuDlZGb4fNWkJzuLU_QgwZP_79IqPlG0IzF-80K7DnjU259zezuIR6a3IDFElpmFG4l2Pvm_ojDhKCZY39SUW79yu9ycuECyAj0xAKs4iewP5XJ-4b5XS8iX_9yJbT1l91vcwPxDu-AZmo3pyD&c=0H5FOk00x8yveu6_82C-BPh4dbAuwAOYy3DcsdW3SrLzYNHwlQ30kw==&ch=vCxviQua00brcmE1JJr196wSBZ_37c0aLFtLmD6NXicLxFwyN4CHYw==)

clean_body: | | | | | == Peter, I want to tell you a story that says more about why I am running for Congress than any slogan or talking point ever could. Earlier this year, in the middle of the afternoon, ICE agents stormed Concordia Cemetery in Forest Park, where I'm proud to serve as Mayor. The workers on site had just tried to help a man who was struggling in the river. They were doing their jobs. They were watching out for human life. They were on private property. Then ICE showed up. Agents cut the lock off the cemetery gate. They pushed their way inside. They fired pepper balls and pepper spray at the workers. They slammed men to the ground. They zip-tied four of them and hauled them away for questioning. And every single one of those workers was a United States citizen. Let me pause on that. These were working people. Groundskeepers. Fathers. Neighbors. They were not suspects. They were not fugitives. They were not even the individuals ICE claimed to be looking for. They were simply in the way. The agents held them for hours. No charges. No explanation. No respect for due process, private property, or basic constitutional rights. I stood with those workers the next day. I listened as they described what it felt like to be thrown to the ground in a place families consider sacred. I heard how agents tried to intimidate them. I saw the bruises. And I made one thing very clear. What happened in that cemetery was unlawful, unconstitutional, and unacceptable. My job as mayor is to protect the people of Forest Park. My job as a lawyer is to stand up for the Constitution. My job as a human being is to defend dignity wherever it is under attack. So I called on ICE leadership to explain why their agents behaved like an unaccountable militia. I demanded answers. I brought attention to the workers' story. I made sure they had support and legal assistance. And I refused to let anyone in Washington pretend this was normal. Because it was not normal. It was lawless federal power unleashed without discipline or respect. And for too long, too many politicians in Congress have looked the other way. I am running for Congress because this cannot continue. If federal agents can break into a cemetery in broad daylight and assault four innocent workers without consequences, then we have lost something fundamental. We have lost the principle that no one is above the law. We have lost the idea that government power must be accountable to the people. We have lost the basic promise that the Constitution protects every single one of us. I am not willing to lose that. == | | == | Your support will help us introduce this campaign to voters who have never heard my name, but who care deeply about fairness, safety, and the rule of law. Thank you for reading this. Thank you for believing in a politics that protects people instead of targeting them. And thank you for standing with me in this fight. clean_body: Accountability isn’t partisan, it’s essential. | Dear Peter, Accountability isn’t partisan, it’s essential. Americans deserve elections that are not only trusted but independently verifiable. Corruption and tyranny thrive when officials lack accountability. Our key question in Colorado and all the United States is simple: if elections are lawful, why are records changed after certification? And if post-certification corrections were needed, how then was the certification process ever accurate? There is no third option. Our data analysts document in our latest Unite4Freedom that certified vote records were altered after certification. Get the Full Story. Click Below for This Week’s Must-Read Updates & Interviews Embrace it. Shape it. Lead with us. | Harry Haury, Chairman of the Board, | Unite4Freedom, a program of United Sovereign Americans, Inc., a 501(c)(4) nonprofit organization, Suite 194, 167 LAMP & LANTERN VILLAGE, CHESTERFIELD, MO 63017

|
Peter,
I'm Hope, Bushra Amiwala's campaign manager.
Early voting is officially underway in parts of IL-9.
The moment we have been building toward since June of last year has finally arrived.
Over countless events and 280 meet-and-greets. Tens of thousands of doors knocked. Hundreds of thousands of phone calls made and texts sent.
All the blood, sweat, and tears brought us to this moment--when voters can finally cast their ballot for Bushra and the movement we have built together.
None of this would have been possible without the support of our hardworking campaign staff, volunteers, and the thousands of Democrats nationwide who believed in Bushra and chipped in their hard earned money.
You built this.
But while early voting has started, we still have 26 days until the polls close -- and tens of thousands of voters left to reach.
This is the final sprint. And we need to leave it all on the field.
Our volunteers have been working around the clock. Morning shifts. Evening shifts. Weekends. They are fired up and ready to win -- but our campaign headquarters is running dangerously low on supplies. We have so many volunteers coming through the doors that we have already blown past our initial food and supply budget.
We have 26 days. We have momentum. And we have a candidate who has earned this moment.
[Let's make sure we finish as strong as we started. Can we count on you to chip in $25, $15, or whatever you can spare today to fuel our final sprint? ## Bayer Offers $7.25B Roundup Settlement
Bayer has proposed a [$7.25 billion class-action settlement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LvOozAQBeCnMZ3RzHBxKFxsQ5dtt0QOHoI3viDjBPH2K9LsA_zdSCMdne_8uU9347yLz98msC5LmiIfu-dSOE8Pc3LeuRTPgWMxLi8pz4zbREC9BJI4TNY4f05tZfXCTNxUrFEpbIeh7bBadQ-Gbzg_bgTDgmAbZXokmHtA1YHtK6evNCAcEBE6rAmUurFStms60yGIFti6knL9N7lYVl78mT6c6zmFyuu1lG0XzS9Bo6DxOI56fuyX4voLGq9T0JjTO9r3Jg9m-3Lec5Zfnwwp7iaWJP9LZUxRrsk-Xy5Kf4ZtTcEIGqus7XY4793eK9HCMxjnvzXKj7b7aPoXAAD___6DhME) to resolve tens of thousands of lawsuits alleging its Roundup weedkiller, containing the controversial herbicide glyphosate, caused non-Hodgkin lymphoma. The deal, filed in St. Louis Circuit Court, would pay out claims over [21 years](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFygzAQBNCvgU6MdCBkChVp6Jw2JXOgw76MkBhJmPjvM3Y-If3Ozr79uk5XZM_h9okb2bLGKdCZPZVCaZrxSSlTKZ42CgU5rTEtpPYJJPRCglDD5JD9c-pqZ1cioLYmq4xR3TB0WtV3214kIuh-1pr0gnJeQMpWtUb3l3Vxa8321SZBDUopqVUD0pgLGeN0q1ErWXWSHJeYmu_Iodxp9c_4oNQscau9vZey56r9qGCsYDzPs1njz3xkDpTzK1PByMEduSRGnysY3y6xp7jHTFkYAXoWu8cg_rAixSO4YxcLhoWS8Hjmg0uuk3X7yd5z7k3VyduG7N8ryr-ue1j4DQAA___0o4TK) to people exposed to Roundup before this week who have been or will be diagnosed with that cancer. Bayer has faced a flood of litigation since acquiring Monsanto in 2018 for $63 billion and has already paid more than [$10 billion in prior verdicts and settlements](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOmzAURb_GbEb2A-MyeEhVMVRKh3bIiB74EVwZG9kmNH9fkaUf0PlKR_ecx328o_MuPH_gRqYscQx0Zk-lUBonfFPKVIqnjUJBl5aYZpL7CAI6LoDLfrTo_HtsK2sWIqCmIiO1lm3ft0pWq8EJoVv0Imw7da0WZFE0YFFZrbBrdOXMRRMgeymlULIGofUX0tqqRqGSgrWCrCsx1b-jC2Wlxb_ji1I9x63yZi1lz6y5MRgYDOd51lsO18ZgoMCPzGBYCX1ZGQyxrJQYDB81ngjnlTLXoCb-T5RfdL7FkDGUmHmKR7DHznGej4zFxXAxMfHbTT7-_PwuWTPE2VnWfPt6paQz_6K0V8nY_XTeu9xp1ornhs5_Tpf_Kv0y8DcAAP__9YGT1w). The German company still faces roughly 67,000 remaining claims. The company, which has [lobbied for a law protecting it from liability](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O6yAURldjd1iAIYSC4jXu8topLQyX5I74sTCO5Vn9yNnC9EefvnO-HvPDYsT8_G8TmBbKnOHYIrQGdV7sCXWD1iIkyM1iDaU6YOvMKb8RygnTs7cYz1n03gQADmMPhinFhNZCsv5lxjt46UYnJNVeCyasEqMD7TTXAEH2aK41yplmjFHJBk6VuoNSXo7SSkY7QcFjK3X4LpjbC0I8yxvq4Erqo3m1tm7d-K_jU8en4ziGEjDZp_3BDBfT8emS6vj0ESKxLAvCRlohG7i9AsGU9oztJKGWRGrZs99X4mx2F452wYjt7Kvx64Ex4nZTnaDPZDF-TrQ_lXsb_hsAAP__rEaE1w), maintains that Roundup is safe and admits no wrongdoing. The Supreme Court is set to hear arguments on the issue in April.
## Air Force One Getting a New Look
The U.S. Air Force confirmed it will [repaint the Air Force One presidential aircraft](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_O3CAQBPCnsbu1AP_hc0GRxt2XNqW1hvV5EwwIuHP89tHdK6QeaTS_-fW9fiN7Do-feJKpe1wDXcVTrZTXDW_KhWr1dFKoyHmP2ZJMqxJqAqFAzqtD9vc6tM7sRIr6lozUWg7zPIyyPcyAJOy4TVpLVLShlsPe719W26nvZ4Etm3ebUHKWUopRdkpo_UVau7EfcZSiGQQ5rjF3vyOHetDu7_ii3Nl4tt4ctabS9D8atTRqua6r2-Pft-KdN2pJ0XNlWxq1IGf4ECAGgmIzpgJsY2ALfygEcjdQRkjIoUKxB50ENT_PBJhSji9ykMnBdXAl2PyTwFHhR2izceli77lMuhnE40T2n331v059GfUvAAD__1SgjrY) in President Trump's preferred red, white, dark blue, and gold color scheme, replacing the light blue and white design that has been in place since the Kennedy administration. The new look will appear on the Qatari-donated 747, [the two Boeing VC-25B](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHOozAQxfHTmI7IM9jxUrjYhi7bbokmeAizMjYyo0S5_Sq5wlc_6S_93t_bfCPJUh5_aOeoa50Lv87MqtzmO725nayaeeeiJG2tbWE4ZrR47S32MM6JJL9n16W4MiMPHUcIAdw4Og_dFu_u6sEh-jUthN4zMC2crAdaebiPncRPzSKMAGA9XNCG8ItDSH7w5MEaZzmJ1nb5V6Xoxmt-1ye3y1L3LsdN9TjN8NvgZHDSjTfJ-bMZnLa68wdkcKK0S5FTG6nUYnDywaFD15O0_uvqa-G-8Ks_SIoanLoW0_GSnOW8BuPsYyf5ljv90VXPiP8DAAD__y4ifOc) jets being built as the next-generation Air Force One, and four C-32 aircraft used by the vice president, the first lady, and Cabinet members. The first C-32 has already been repainted and is expected to be delivered in the coming months. [See images here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAYBOCnsTsswGDiguIad7n2SovYg0OEwcL_BWWffpVU2289o9Gn-Xedry7EkLa_bocln-eEekYQocw390I5QRSxI5ELxeeyQByz5HJgXDIxzqsL8TWrdrUekOhbWGGMUOOotGjvVkMbdbktfhi9MugHJcH10Cu3eCx-bIN9r3EpRiEE16KT3JgLjFl1r50WvFEca6BcukcOie7w8ZWfKN2S9zbaO9FxNv2fRk6NnGqtHdWvd9bIyYXSyGlhvXTMhcI-fkY1sweIYUfZcLIKV0LaGJX_-3GyhPqjnBPY4UIi9si3ttj1qCHGcA6mUXzbXYgfB_3qvKeV3wEAAP__dR2EaA). Trump initially proposed the redesign during his first term, but the Biden administration [reversed it](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO8yAQBOCnsTssdo1DKCj-Jl3-9kprbZaEOwwWJkF5-1PyCtePZvTN13W-Uogh3f7Txrb6PCduR-RaucwLvbgcXGvkjVOlUHwuK8M-o8STkCjAzI5CfM2qd9YzI489W9AalDFqgv5uCWhBt7A-k0G1Gu_Oi3eglIPFL6Pvg323SQQDAHKCAaXWZ9baTeNEE8hOSXah5jJ855DqnX185SeXYc1bH-291v3oxn8dXjq8tNaGN6Ex_7wDHV5cThSdqOWx7YJCER-FyInFY3dUWSRuYs0xl0MUfjJFdgJgUmgk9sW6vYUYw3HSnZK3jUL8TNc__fW0-BsAAP__5_KAPA), citing concerns that darker colors could cause overheating on certain components.
## Shiffrin Wins Gold After 8-Year Drought
Mikaela Shiffrin [dominated the women's slalom](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAQRU9jOpA9wBoKF2noNm1K5MXjZZKxjWxrEbePNldI__Wf3vu6r3dLTPH5aQOa6tMa8SyMtWJeH_bCXLBWxoCxWso-5Q3VsYKEWyuhVfPqLPG1Do0zHhGwb9AordUwz8Oomt3oWbrJ-9miU7rfYHLTw4KXPaC8gdcNmfebBDUrpeSoOpBaT6i1G_vRjkqKQaKjmnL3nSjWHT1f6YW521Jo2Oy1HkX0HwIWAct5nl18bImvcNBW3hsBy1tKwBLoxyLbtuzkfabYnhRLW9hyCu0zsWuyccdJzFRuWgzyGSzxH6f-K87LwG8AAAD__xt-ebI) at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Wednesday, finishing 1.5 seconds ahead of the field, the largest margin in an Olympic women's slalom since 1998. It's her third career Olympic gold, making her the [only American alpine skier in history to hold three](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd1gwgUdcUGxD97bd0sJmnMwKgwWjWP77VSLtF7z6Skf3nD_f83ekTOXxO-7oeatzwbNnZMY2L_HC1pE5446FI7WtthX1MYOCL6lA6mlOkfI1myH5DRHwNqDXzmkzTcbq4ekn7Ral7D0ZDc5taYnaIixo0prQrmkg_6Yp0JPWWlk9gnLujs4le7PRaiWMwkRc2_i3UuEnbvmqL2zjWvch-yfz0cXtl4AgIJznOWI_ynsUEGq-9oPWLiB0ru0SEGYBgZKAYNxk705pAeHjs1OORa61MZUoiWO-5EmFscn_GLlgZ7nXd44uT0wFe4rX0Hw6TsqZ-pcTRj32SPlzj3_U9OXhXwAAAP__4CGLVw). The 30-year-old hadn't won an Olympic medal since 2018 and went 0-for-6 in Beijing four years ago, a stretch she later called her lowest point in the sport. In Italy, a fourth-place finish in the combined and an 11th in giant slalom left her staring down her final event without a medal. Then she posted the [fastest first run by nearly a full second](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQRZ_GdEb28GMoXKSh27QpkcEDTGQwsmcX8fYRK-UJvnrOXN1z_7zGl6NAx_rb7Wh5ieOBVw7IjGmc3I0pI3PAHQ92lJaYZtTnCApaqUDqfvSOwj3WhbcLImBVoNXG6Lrv60YXmzUGZm3qdsaprSuFxpm-m5tumUw3OeUKsk-aAt1rrVWjS1DGdGiMb6rGNVqJWqEnjqn8G-ngDZdwxw-mco57EezGfGZR_RIwCBiu6yrnKeczJs4PIWCI4d5PmrOA4bF7KDoYk_x_kF-fQB-U79M7xiy9u6UGmTC_A2e50boFWjd-vh9QwFAk68-LQqDcGlGrdXcUvqX4R0t-LPwLAAD__z5ViKs) and never looked back.

Hi Peter,
My name is Val Nosler Beck and I am the Executive Director for Colorado Draws The Line.
We launched late last year as a direct response to Donald Trump's push to gerrymander red state congressional districts to lock Democrats out of power in 2026 and for generations to come.
In Colorado, we have an independent, bipartisan redistricting commission that redraws districts every ten years. We value independent redistricting in this state.
But it's not just unfair for blue states like ours to suffer the consequences of Trump's power grab without being able to fight back -- it's intolerable.
We refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch Trump destroy democracy. If our initiative is successful, we will authorize emergency redistricting in Colorado that could flip 3 or even 4 GOP-held seats to Democrats.
If that's all you need to hear and you are ready to help us fight back and make Donald Trump feel some pain, please donate at the following link: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdtl-email](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001pHAa2GchNENGidiU1gJc7nJ9jlTs-s_qPidCCae06TaJkzyZxNfGoHPuhTCS8ec7Fp1pC4obzVpiw5A0BvWPJHZCTOWXx9iGiTdWIaT6ySz9cNHFNhXJ-rQXGRQ9gM66Oa9rMR2SauY_9_nUhKMZJ_XLSZ61Qc7eJH9eJw9cbcwqPyd6X1mTPeUOFsVohQbH3M8dV7dJ9FXSZEw__N6cXg==&c=EYOuwD36lLW1cFV0gT7k_ZgCeG9AAa4CUKS8h7XNGKsApmmon7B6Dw==&ch=ydRdBTeOuWisx700TitvAJqXBlh2taWP5v33NDxGJ-bwNr-XK6pLlA==)
Peter, I want to be completely upfront about this: it is going to take a monumental effort to pull off this ballot measure campaign.
This is what it is going to take to defeat Trump's scheme to rig enough congressional districts so that Republicans won't ever lose the House again:
-Finance: My team estimates we will need close to $3 million to win, more if the GOP spends money to try and defeat our ballot measure.
-Signature gathering: To qualify for the ballot, we must gather and submit 200,000 valid signatures from registered voters in all 35 state senate districts.
-Deadline: All of this must happen by May 2026.
I am confident we can do this together.
We're trying something completely different here: an entirely grassroots-funded, bottom-up campaign to fight back against MAGA's assault on American democracy.
Most campaigns are top-heavy dark money operations that rely on large corporate or wealthy donors to meet the budget they need to succeed.
Colorado Draws The Line is not like that. Ours is a powerful statement of grassroots resistance to Trump's anti-American attempt to rig the outcome of our elections.
[Our average donation is $15. You can be the difference between a huge win for democracy - or yet another victory for Trump. Our future is for us to decide. Please help us make it one we can all be proud of:](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001pHAa2GchNENGidiU1gJc7nJ9jlTs-s_qPidCCae06TaJkzyZxNfGoHPuhTCS8ec7_3h27uevP_EPAToJMVQFyDaHJk4w_i56MgFBHldZtmCBjWDNBws4TZgFxCxA-R9uxGBeG1qeSB6aq_Vf_qooJslEO4vcJbm9ten4RrOVWEnQd-VRs6klh2_VJw093T-rjvuEnptNTWlRZOmec-Arnqby5NMvVlrv&c=EYOuwD36lLW1cFV0gT7k_ZgCeG9AAa4CUKS8h7XNGKsApmmon7B6Dw==&ch=ydRdBTeOuWisx700TitvAJqXBlh2taWP5v33NDxGJ-bwNr-XK6pLlA==)

If our initiative is successful, we will authorize emergency redistricting in Colorado that could flip 3 or even 4 GOP-held seats to Democrats. If that's all you need to hear and you are ready to help us fight back and make Donald Trump feel some pain, please donate at the following link: == Peter, I want to be completely upfront about this: it is going to take a monumental effort to pull off this ballot measure campaign. Most campaigns are top-heavy dark money operations that rely on large corporate or wealthy donors to meet the budget they need to succeed. Colorado Draws The Line is not like that. _**EXHIBIT 1 - JOINT FUNDRAISING NOTICE **_

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. The contributor's signature designates his or her contribution to the elections described above. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

| Friends--
Legislation to establish a Paid Family and Medical Leave program has passed on the floor of the House and Senate. [HB1207](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kvTfFGThJRm6ptfyPRI3mUCHJHgf5ips3vlfNWY2a51-OQg_obe63oDdDfg3NiyDpVnOEESxHjeJwH5e3jePF9411PZ_-IOnbBX0IYtjYCB3XZVNOBAYSlxftZEdDJgzqZZlAGlbgsXWGjsp2YmZTbAvkdLFWWRxmI9S40Lm0unXOnfxdoZ4UnIUmtN0m3Un&c=nuCiSBztdd_GZSIniVE3hN-jGd9Lh7nZfL1FCoEm5ABz3UuF0V_XwQ==&ch=PJ3Hb7fU9r9O9Dvdpxw0T0GX_zaN8nKA0J7V4ayYOMVtit2Cp3PB8A==), patroned by Delegate Briana Sewell (D-Woodbridge), passed by a 62-34 vote, and [SB2](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kvTfFGThJRm6ptfyPRI3mUCHJHgf5ips3vlfNWY2a51-OQg_obe63oDdDfg3NiyDy7utr2u_lnEdqV2w8DSq-eV_69xRfVjtn6TG6vmW_x2D1jcMb9_OvhRlGfwaVA1mjpbL1z1ijOhOFjETU2c-nLPTUdhLQyizetsnQGr937C4BN0sLVmjdrbESc1KcMes&c=nuCiSBztdd_GZSIniVE3hN-jGd9Lh7nZfL1FCoEm5ABz3UuF0V_XwQ==&ch=PJ3Hb7fU9r9O9Dvdpxw0T0GX_zaN8nKA0J7V4ayYOMVtit2Cp3PB8A==), patroned by Senator Jennifer Boysko (D-Fairfax), passed by a 21-19 vote. Both bills will now cross over to the other chamber.
This bill will guarantee that nearly [3.4 million Virginia workers](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kvTfFGThJRm6ptfyPRI3mUCHJHgf5ips3vlfNWY2a51-OQg_obe63v4DCucmd1jzF2fLkhAPnoAIEI1qdUtw-YOOtFRw_PuPtRqutdtB3WUp6QLwQDOkcJWupTiSPqdBtukDlb_sbgDTSOq70ViM4096K0clyQU2MBgOZVpgV4LuyRFx119YIceuqMWEg5GqXagG_jnv5AExzmZdYRqiyzJxD8mvJ6R6Ly6kfYywB5efDaF3fX-XDVoGoNH8d1JsU96iQw7SOHM=&c=nuCiSBztdd_GZSIniVE3hN-jGd9Lh7nZfL1FCoEm5ABz3UuF0V_XwQ==&ch=PJ3Hb7fU9r9O9Dvdpxw0T0GX_zaN8nKA0J7V4ayYOMVtit2Cp3PB8A==) have access to Paid Family and Medical Leave, ensuring up to 12 weeks of leave for events such as a new baby, serious illness, or injury, with 80% wage replacement and protection of their health care coverage.

## Texas Teen Awarded $3.2M for False Racism Claim
A Collin County jury awarded 19-year-old Asher Vann $3.2 million after a classmate's mother [falsely portrayed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ8GulnZAwuhcJGG7qZNiQZ7zDoazMo2sLx9xH2F2x3pSOfn-_s1fVGQEJc_tLIpH79Nkc8sXAqnaY9pl-tNOXNcODkuFCI7RxMq7EAh6GFyFOSa2tqZWblB12x03-unwmen65fhdna_Ov_sutlqbBz32g-daq1l26tB18HcYQr1oFFhMzxadI21fmbsZ_9sVdUqdqFs6VFeXPhD2cu1HZwedltrMa9S3rlqflc4Vjie5_nw2-d-cfsVjiu7QBWOhTmCJ8ksF5C1e2YHiSzDTLecd5ErxAXOEDM0gCscnFywBXzaVviuhn97uoB84QRHSCRAIrxQCVvMdTLufQaRkLu-atWyUpDvleVnbA-D_wMAAP__1RuSpQ) him as a racist bully for "doing immature dumb things" with a group of friends five years ago. During a February 2021 sleepover, Vann and his friends played a game where they shot each other with BB guns and airsoft rifles. Later, they agreed that the first person to fall asleep would [get pranked](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2ypSAQBeDVYMYtaP-eAcEkZm_SCa1GGmUK0YLW-9z9lHcLE3fXV-ecP9_TN4YY0vIbNzL84_cp0btEYqY8nSmf8T6wFEoLZUeMIZFzOIGCTiqQepgchnhPTeWMVW7QFRnd97pV0Ha6Ws2XQrTWO9_0Aw2Dplr3Wmvdees7q9oqmAdToAcNCurh1YCr59lbgt76tlGiUeQC7_nFKzH9YPHx3i_Kr3nfqmhW5qOI-peAUcCY7mMv_JwEjI8sYFQgYNRfAsazyKefgPEDSSZKEstKWV6YksQ3ZkdO1hI2-ffMt7wouzCzRM_PU8gYZcY5FJb2jPEOaZFzxLA9aJWNO94hxlC6XjRq2TDET0z-v3EvA_8CAAD__9uhj2A). When SeMarion Humphrey fell asleep, Vann woke him up and handed him a cup of urine. "_He put it up to his mouth, willingly and on his own accord, and gave it back because he knew it wasn't water_ ," Vann said in an [interview](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkT2O4zAMhU9jdwwkWfFP4WKbdLPtlgYlUTYRWQ4kZpLcfuG5wjQkQOL7gIf372v5Qk6c17-40yzveCyZXjWRCJXlmcszfR5YK-WVSiBBzhQCLkaZHpQBPS0BOX0W24bZqTDplmY9DPqqzLXX7TZj7KcuWm2dC2McyHrrx1GP0XdxHF3f8nzKlNGTNsp008Wa0HkfHZnBxatVjVUUWI5ykY2E3lhj-hzfVC7-2Ns0byKP2nR_GnNrzC0WIkfoj3y-G3PbKTCeGzlXKYQ7_JzAFULZEtWaPuBPIQXADJgSrRRgQyHwhXcCzvDa2G_nFII7hwrxKP4EwCX0d_AJa91PRA4IhfMdnoUzAQu8sALCypgFtgPfjbm1ZQ6PF6fEtR8aq9YdOf0Ekt_V8D2b_wEAAP__IzKiJA) with the _Washington Free Beacon_. A few weeks later, Humphrey's mother hired an attorney, started a GoFundMe for "therapy and private schooling," and embarked on a media tour to share how her son was "tortured" by Vann. A grand jury [declined to indict](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ_GZD2ym79x4GASdMlectJdiBq7GSwZg2yzLG9_Yl9hs5I-6VNV_fsYP8gHH9-_aWVTvuZtjHzmwKVwGo-YjnDtlDPHNyfHhXxk52hEiR1IBKVHRz5cY1M5M0mnVcVG9b1qJbadqhbTWt1MdUvUtaieT_1s7MR6olmRZK2x8uaWSVRaocRaPxp0tbXzxNhPc9tI0Uh2vmzpURYu_EV5Dtf2yelht7UKZillz6J-CRwEDud5PtYcbyZw4AhHFjjcowQO35lgDxQ3yOVwHAuclMFSCOyAIJH1ucB0hHDB4jOQtUfmlCFuJ6xHLrDTTVaoEVYfgt_iLU3weqm_f9pfVCXj9vMmuetFI98r-fDdtfzs4U-D_wMAAP__lF-R2A), but Vann was subjected to online threats and "lost all my friends." "It was immature. It was stupid. It was nasty. But that's not who I am, and that's not me today," Vann [said after the verdict](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAQRb8Gd3SgRHksXMzG3ZvtLE0JZTdJNRjA9vn3E-cXZn2Tk3vOn-_lGyPH9PyNb5raz5aXRGdlao3KcqRy8LVjrZSeVAI1jIlCwAUUjFKB1G4JGPlaTBemVQWnO5q0tXpQMIy6e019MEje2TD6cVwtBG1oUGiMsQZ0b7o43TAF2mlQ0LuHgdB7v60Edt0Go4RRFGLL5dFe1OgH68ZX_lB5-PzueHq1tlfR_xIwC5jP83ycG-I9CpixtOiZBMy3l4CZs0cWMPvMHJP0-UjtEjDvjCnLgj4iy_VgvmJ6SsazHrHJd2SOOVV5lJhIViba7wvyEwNlATN8WYkOeqscSvvlR2loU3J13krQBlenvsgNa1emsJ83rY5WGPV8Y-R_Iu3_8n8m-BsAAP__pZSZ0g), acknowledging "there was no winner in the end." Humphrey's mother said she plans to appeal.
## Delta Flight Disrupted by 'Unruly' Passenger
An unruly passenger forced a Delta Air Lines flight to [return](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0QwtuOkcLGNu7ftlhYwY3u0BBBMkue_X2V_4dVX9-jo_PlavxxHTvtv96BZvre8Jnq3SCJU12eqz3gW1xqlnSqSOE6E6FYwcNUGtL2v6Die69Dh7A3ebUeznSY7GhivtjtmO95GTyYgWuwnvAHdBmtHazY_9QGx4_kDM2DvFgz098sA2IeweYLJb-Ng1GAIWXK9yEFC365t8cwvqpeQH12cD5HSVP9LwaJgcT7Y_rMoWEpuomA58rNJTrrkyIE0pxc14d0Jp123QIn0kb0_teNachUdcvhbWPTbNe0ruXAQ6kK15aRz8tlV1EhR3OcROVFTsNjb1Y7TOChYujpjeXOM3K6TGsz-cBz_28rPGr9m-BcAAP__s6-TsA) to Houston's William P. Hobby Airport shortly after takeoff on Wednesday morning. According to a [statement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OwyAQhJ8Gd7Zg_RcXFNe4y7VXWrCsY3TEINjE8dufkle4-tOMZr6f63I1Pvj99m3upPm1xmWnowRiprw89vwIZzKl0H6j7IiN38k5s4CEoZZQq2lxxodz6SqnrXSTqkircVS9hH5Q1aZxQkuonLrgdJlwRGP6Xo0jQSdX20Ll9btMgpoUSGinpgPXIq6WYLRr30nRSXKeY254I6aXKWs445Nyg_FeBb0xpyLaLwGzgPk4jga3HPc3FTC_7wiYt_goHPf6kxcwm8weA32ItWdtfE4xc40Rf5Pn2mYyuJGrQbWDbNuuSVuqsnbp8CH4Moyik7e78eGzgv_n7qnhLwAA__-aY4UN) from the carrier, the unidentified passenger exhibited "unruly and unlawful behavior toward other customers" but "did not make contact with or attempt to access the flight deck." The pilot reportedly [told air traffic control](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAQRb8GMyxoHX0GBC8hm003tBAapQbBgp5x5u-33F_YuE_1ufd-3-e7CTGk9cvsqOjt85zwrBGJsMzPVJ7xc5haMa1YHJIJCZ0zMwgYuAAup9mZED9z3zi1CDfJBpUcR3kTcBtks6lunHw_dF5OTgymQxiF8GKZlgVxGHvbBHU9EyAnCQK6qe3Bddb6BWFc_K0XrBfoAuXS0oaEb1N9_OQXltbmvYlqIzoq6_4z0Az0eZ6tjcE-YMvPSjldFAN91WKgY7YmMtCXk4EWwEDLfwx0wSMX4tlzQ4T7Qei4zfZxBOJLQWM3HtILK4XVXLecuMNIhvsY1o34dlx88qHsl6cpyh1niDHUYWS9WHcT4m9g-tvMLwU_AQAA___uvZNz) that "we had a passenger get up and try to access the cockpit." "_He punched me three times and then walked back and then started attacking another gentleman behind me_ ," [said passenger Josh Lamas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOkdmWYdQUFxD9197JbK9S1j9DkZm8xPe_sS9wpWj0Yxmvj9f05eXJOvzt3_xoJ85Tysfe2JVLtN7Le90bn7feX1yIVYvKxP5CSzcjQXT9BN5SeeENQ3BUt_UPDRd1zgL7t7Uy2AR5-gsk3dI-HCujy3OgXtLGAPNtQxXmYWmb8BC298QqI1xDgxdmB3aCi2TaC43XVj54_c5nfmHyy3mV52GRXXbq_ZXBWMF43Ect-8lvy-zgtEXlZi4gvH6VcEYi7wuSZzUmznJc1Gz5BBO46VsuaiJOX5vokbWKMSrmi0niVcIHs6EgLFrgjMOMRjsHmgeTGyi545da-99F-sy0HZISrLfuwrt8-Ul_Zur_wf5Z4C_AQAA__8GcZES). "_Everyone assumed that he was just kind of not mentally there_." The passenger was detained when the Atlanta-bound flight returned to the airport. ## Historic Jail Sold to Hospitality Developer

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Your bank doesn't own the money in your account...

YOU do.

...Right?

Well, that's what most people think...

But here's the **harsh truth** :

When you deposit money into a bank, you're technically loaning it to them...

And if that bank gets into financial trouble, **they can use YOUR deposits to save their own skin.**

It's called a **"bail-in"** and it's been **100% legal in America since 2010.**

Find out more on the next page [👉 Is Your Bank Safe?](https://links.research.firstinvestmentupdates.com/u/click?_t=6c5e8d0087884bb7b7cd2e3abb0e6b5f&_m=9f2d7778f0f64e66bf05b56a94f27ae8&_e=9oSwwmLYlp9VhBYka06NYIlXNV4mLsrSnlj-DPshV9qppExY3w3iRTUFMcJ7LwggEEIMCZ8A0asiVlL3ntFlqX5l47GCyRNIR7G2s1GVu8ykavsgEBoSsHMh3CVu_tmsMIpYIJrq9eIeRU2IHSF139YkzoY9PTrVBkENp6PSd92DjJKSdASPbvFtZVU_UXVB_OSL1oRb8n_B89OGpcaA6b9QYefxHANnQ5fGr5n_PEliooeJ3KIud_Jc1EaQw3aYKiXq53Nu3eKj7YhT_HbhbSSkq8AWNHJ5mSQxc2AQvTGSWhjM3lCbtpKsChIMq_E5VAkxfIEVXKsfJ182I-7USo1CDSDtx96H8K2E7Uf9INgjKznha2JQ2Yu1FA6u3yNyvbK0o4ixTFc6vjvExJ50MZvumSaDBllGrB-ZU_uyVYihfZ6g-rvK458bBKtCdwCzVy3jCzSqylLZAu0EzP2E5cnkfQK061e3TS6I9sW25OqgHwu1je6jjJ2d39YXT8AWvrA4BSj9O8PQHo9zKZa7CJjgghcI7Jj7vmEJA2SOL3bcPxVY5MeRDu0y8hs1tE8dV_MBMBS50btlmkgi1DKQWZJ_OIWXtufKCpGv00RAKm83NUpF5ZsUx0aghsnIchez)

**This isn't conspiracy theory stuff...**

During financial crises, this exact thing happened in Cyprus in 2013 and in Lebanon in 2019.

In Lebanon:

* There were more than $72 BILLION in losses...
* Depositors faced ~$400 monthly withdrawal restrictions on their accounts...
* And some even turned to **armed robbery of their own banks in a desperate attempt to access their life savings.**

Now, if you're thinking this can happen in America because we're "covered by FDIC insurance"...

That's true...

But it's only up to $250,000 per account...

And here's what they don't advertise much:

**The FDIC's "emergency" reserve fund holds just 1.28% of total insured deposits.**

So, if multiple major banks failed simultaneously, that fund would likely be **exhausted almost immediately.**
