Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40874%2E3422442%2EpP_im0)
Peter, it's Elizabeth Warren.
**I’m thrilled to share today that I’m officially endorsing Katie Porter’s campaign for governor in California.**
I’ll tell you more below about why I’m backing Katie, but first you should know that winning a statewide election in California requires a lot of resources in order to hire staff, run ads, and share Katie’s progressive message. Katie has never taken a cent of corporate money, and unlike some of her opponents she can’t self-fund her own campaign.
**[That’s why she’s counting on grassroots supporters to power her campaign and win in California. So, can you please make a donation of $5 or anything you can to support Katie’s campaign?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260219_1_ak.EhN0h_&refcode=em20260219-40874&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=40874%2E3422442%2EpP_im0)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260219_1_ak.EhN0h_&refcode=em20260219-40874&t=4&akid=40874%2E3422442%2EpP_im0)
I still remember the day when I met Katie. My consumer law class was early in the morning, meaning a lot of students had their heads down, trying to avoid being called on.
But not Katie. She was determined and ready to go. When the first answer she gave wasn’t her strongest, she came to my office hours and said, “Please keep calling on me. I am going to learn to do this.”
Getting to know her, I saw her bone-deep commitment to making a difference in people’s lives.
When Katie decided to run for Congress in 2018, I was very happy to support her. I knew that we needed more people like her in Washington—who understood the real struggles that working families faced, who had the courage to stand up to big corporations and special interests, and who would fight to make our government work for everyone.
With Donald Trump back in office, working families need Katie’s leadership more than ever. It’s not just enough to elect any Democrat to be California’s next governor. California families deserve a changemaker, a fighter, and a whip-smart leader like Katie who will defend their values and deliver results.
**[So please, if you can, make a donation of $5 or anything you can to support Katie’s campaign. We’re going to keep fighting to make our government work for working people—and we need you in this fight.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260219_1_ak.EhN0h_&refcode=em20260219-40874&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=40874%2E3422442%2EpP_im0)**

Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20260219-40874&amounts=&t=25&refcode2=40874_3422442_pP_im0&akid=40874%2E3422442%2EpP_im0)**

I'm requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master's from Harvard, a Master's Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. I'm starting this race with absolutely nothing , but because of the enormity of the race's outcome, I figured there is no harm in asking for your help. At the end of the day, my request of you will end in one of two ways: 1.) . 2.) you read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I'm not a career politician. I'm a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation's call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn't the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don't live in Minnesota, then I'm sure you'll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today—individuals of integrity. That's not who my opponent is. We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven't done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. subject: A grim milestone
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
Derek , this month marks a grim milestone – one year ago, Donald Trump and Elon Musk shut down the United States Agency for International Development, or USAID.
I want to talk about why this has been so bad for both the United States and the world, and why I’m asking you to split a donation between me and Tim Kaine [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-warner?amount=25] .
When Trump and his allies went after USAID, they said they were cutting "foreign aid." What they actually did was take aim at programs that fight pandemics, feed hungry kids, and grow economies. And the damage doesn't stop at our borders. Gutting USAID is dangerous for Americans right here at home.
The truth is, USAID was one of the smartest investments America made in its own security and prosperity – and it’s why I fought like hell to protect it. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-warner?amount=25]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-warner?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-warner?amount=25]
USAID contracts supported American farmers who feed the world, and keep our children healthy. It stopped pandemics before they arrived at our shores. It created over 10,000 American jobs at home and overseas – including many right here in Virginia. And USAID helped us counter foreign powers like China and Russia that are seeking to expand their global influence and undermine the United States' global leadership.
Let's be clear: when Trump and Musk tore down USAID, they tore down a pillar of America's national security.
And in the year since, they have continued to sow chaos and corruption at home and around the globe. Yet my Republican colleagues in the Senate have done nothing meaningful to stop it. Time and time again, they bend the knee, refusing to stand up to Trump's dangerous agenda.
It's become clear that if Republicans won't hold this president accountable for his actions that make our country weaker and all of us less safe, then we need to elect leaders who will.
But we need you in this fight with us. Virginia is at the center of the battle for the House and Senate. Winning here is critical if we are going to flip control of Congress in November. Friend, Right now, across the country, we are seeing something incredible: **Democrats are winning "impossible" elections.** From deep-red pockets to the suburbs, people are choosing common sense over chaos. But instead of listening to what voters actually want, Washington Republicans are panicking. They’re worried they can't win fair and square—so they’re trying to choose their voters instead of letting the voters choose them. **Next week, the Senate is set to vote on the SAVE Act.** They’re calling it "election integrity" but let’s be clear: **this is a desperate attempt to silence millions of Americans**. If this bill passes, a driver's license won't be enough to register to vote. You would be required to provide physical "documentary proof of citizenship"—like a birth certificate or passport—in person. This isn't about security—** it's about creating hurdles for the voters they're hurting most**:
* **Women:** An estimated **69 million American women** have names on their birth certificates that don’t match their current ID because of marriage or divorce. This bill would treat a hyphen or a name change like a legal disqualification.
* **Naturalized Citizens:** It treats our immigrant neighbors—people who have sworn an oath to this country—with immediate suspicion, forcing them to show their papers to exercise their right to vote.
* **Trans Tennesseans:** For the trans community, who have already done the hard work of updating their documents to reflect who they are, this bill creates a bureaucratic nightmare designed to push them out of the booth.

**Your right to vote shouldn't depend on political whims. It is yours regardless of who you are or how you vote.** Senator Marsha Blackburn is standing ten toes down for this political theater. She’s more interested in protecting her own power than protecting your rights. We need to show her that Tennesseans won't be silenced. body:
Every voice, and vote, matters

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=7599%2E400544%2EplS2VX)
---
Did you know that I've traveled to every single one of New Mexico's 33 counties, Friend? That's because I believe _every_ New Mexican, no matter where they're from, deserves to be heard. ** _[And together, we're building a powerful grassroots movement — one that's strong enough to keep our state blue.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4682?refcode=jtk271-fr-nd&t=2&akid=7599%2E400544%2EplS2VX)_**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4682?refcode=jtk271-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7599%2E400544%2EplS2VX)
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4682?refcode=jtk271-fr-nd&t=4&akid=7599%2E400544%2EplS2VX)
---
Every voice matters. Every vote matters. That is why I am committed to showing up and listening to as many people as I can about how we move forward together and build a future where everyone has a real chance to thrive. In fact, my team and I have already traveled over 15,000 miles to hear from folks like you, including those in rural communities who are so often left out.
Since launching this campaign, people have welcomed me into their living rooms. I’ve sat with them around their dinner tables and joined community gatherings. I've heard their stories, their worries, and their ideas for the future — and it's clear that people want a governor who will fight fiercely to make things better for our communities.
Like many New Mexicans, I know what it’s like to struggle. I was a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on government programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy. Every day, as hard as it was, I had to get back up and keep going.
That’s exactly why I’m better prepared to lead. I understand affordability because I’ve lived it. I know how critical strong public schools, accessible health care, and safe communities are because my family relied on them. These issues aren’t abstract to me — they’re personal. And beyond my lived experience, I’ve led at the highest levels of government, serving in Congress and as U.S. Secretary of the Interior, where I took on tough fights and delivered real results for communities across the country. I know how to fight for working families — and how to get things done.
Experience matters. Leadership matters. And I’m ready. But the truth is simple: _I can't do this without you._
**Now that we're in an election year and I'm officially on the ballot, Friend, I need your help to continue meeting voters where they are and making sure their voices are heard.**_[Please, will you rush $5 or more now to help me hit my $30,000 mid-month goal, win in New Mexico, and deliver progress for working families across our state?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4682?refcode=jtk271-fr-nd&t=5&akid=7599%2E400544%2EplS2VX)_

Be fierce,
Deb

**[🚨 Tell Congress: Hold ICE accountable for rights of pregnant women in detention 🚨](https://click.everyaction.com/k/125720930/602696526/484358469?sourceid=1151183&utm_campaign=ice&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWU4MjZhMC1jNDBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iqkZ8rvBymuH8FCwOnA9SRD-aImm2sl0r6BlrkvsLyc=&emci=bb7c299a-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=b9e826a0-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237)** Peter, we are deeply concerned by reports of pregnant women in Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention being denied adequate food, water, living conditions, and timely medical care. And tragically, some women in detention have suffered miscarriages. | [TELL CONGRESS: INVESTIGATE ICE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/125720931/602696527/484358469?sourceid=1151183&utm_campaign=ice&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWU4MjZhMC1jNDBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iqkZ8rvBymuH8FCwOnA9SRD-aImm2sl0r6BlrkvsLyc=&emci=bb7c299a-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=b9e826a0-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237)
---
[Members of Congress have already identified hundreds of credible reports of abuse in immigration detention.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/125720932/602696528/484358469?sourceid=1151183&utm_campaign=ice&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWU4MjZhMC1jNDBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iqkZ8rvBymuH8FCwOnA9SRD-aImm2sl0r6BlrkvsLyc=&emci=bb7c299a-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=b9e826a0-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237) According to one senator's findings, pregnant women are waiting weeks for sub-par care, are being forced to sleep on the floor due to overcrowding, and are being denied adequate food and water.

[Immigrants who are pregnant, postpartum, or nursing should not be detained.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/125720933/602696529/484358469?sourceid=1151183&utm_campaign=ice&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWU4MjZhMC1jNDBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iqkZ8rvBymuH8FCwOnA9SRD-aImm2sl0r6BlrkvsLyc=&emci=bb7c299a-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=b9e826a0-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237) Pregnancy does not pause because someone is detained—and detention should never make pregnancy more dangerous. How can an administration that claims to be _pro-mother_ and _pro-child_ , allow this to happen?
[HOLD ICE ACCOUNTABLE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/125720934/602696530/484358469?sourceid=1151183&utm_campaign=ice&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWU4MjZhMC1jNDBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iqkZ8rvBymuH8FCwOnA9SRD-aImm2sl0r6BlrkvsLyc=&emci=bb7c299a-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=b9e826a0-c40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237)

# [Palantir bolts, leaves blue Colorado for red Florida](https://substack.com/redirect/e88b938c-9dd1-42dc-abc4-c1ded2c906ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
AI powerhouse Palantir Technologies **[has relocated its headquarters from Denver,](https://substack.com/redirect/e88b938c-9dd1-42dc-abc4-c1ded2c906ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e88b938c-9dd1-42dc-abc4-c1ded2c906ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Colorado, to Miami, Florida,](https://substack.com/redirect/e88b938c-9dd1-42dc-abc4-c1ded2c906ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** marking the latest chapter in the ongoing exodus of tech firms from high-tax states to business-friendly Florida amid no state income tax and surging capital migration.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e88b938c-9dd1-42dc-abc4-c1ded2c906ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tax-free allure drives** : Florida boasts no state income tax, low business regulations, and top rankings for GDP growth and talent attraction, fueling a massive influx of capital and companies.
* **Second major relocation** : This marks Palantir's second HQ shift in six years, following its 2020 departure from Silicon Valley over clashing values with the region's culture.
* **Aventura office confirmed** : The new principal executive office is at 19505 Biscayne Boulevard, Suite 2350, in affluent Aventura, about 20 miles north of downtown Miami.
* **Broader tech migration** : Palantir joins billionaires like Peter Thiel, Jeff Bezos, and firms fleeing high-tax states like California amid proposed wealth taxes for pro-business policies in South Florida.

# [Mamdani's math-defying tax hike nightmare](https://substack.com/redirect/57e69f41-1a8b-4220-946c-93f6189447d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani **[threatened a 9.5% property tax increase](https://substack.com/redirect/57e69f41-1a8b-4220-946c-93f6189447d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as a "last resort" to close a $5.4 billion budget gap if Albany refuses to tax the ultra-wealthy and corporations, prompting real estate experts to warn of soaring rents, accelerated taxpayer flight and severe market disruption for middle-class residents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/57e69f41-1a8b-4220-946c-93f6189447d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Experts decry flawed math** : Real estate pros from Douglas Elliman call the plan a "math-defying disaster" that ignores economic realities and creates dangerous uncertainty in NYC's housing market.
* **Rents face sharp increases** : Higher property taxes often pass quickly to tenants, with average monthly rents already at $3,454 potentially rising further and hitting working families hardest.
* **Taxpayer exodus accelerates** : The proposal risks driving high earners and buyers to low-tax states like Florida and Texas, shrinking the city's tax base and leaving middle-class New Yorkers to bear the burden.
* **Market slows dramatically** : Even discussing the hike influences buyer behavior, pausing deals and prompting shifts to suburbs or out-of-state options amid fears of long-term instability.

# **[Austin household boom explodes past national pace](https://substack.com/redirect/c46429a7-4c2c-468c-90fe-264138053a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Austin's metro area **[surged with 357,000 new households over the past decade,](https://substack.com/redirect/c46429a7-4c2c-468c-90fe-264138053a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c46429a7-4c2c-468c-90fe-264138053a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)rocketing 51% from 2014 to 2024--about four times faster than the U.S. average of 13%--fueled by waves of young professionals and retirees snapping up rentals, starter homes, and downsizing options, according to National Association of Realtors data.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e64fe7e1-d9b3-449d-9acd-66f2c1b509b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Explosive decade growth** : Austin metro added 357,000 households, jumping from 703,976 to 1,061,155 between 2014 and 2024 for a dramatic 51% rise.
* **Youth influx drives demand** : Households under 25 climbed from 5.1% to 5.9% share, while 25-34 edged up slightly, boosting rentals and entry-level housing amid job migration.
* **Seniors fuel steady expansion** : Older groups grew notably, with 65-74 rising from 9.5% to 10.7% and over-75 from 5.6% to 7%, increasing need for low-maintenance and age-in-place properties.
* **Middle ages lag behind** : Shares for 35-64 households dipped slightly, yet broad age diversity sustains strong, varied demand across starter, move-up, and specialized housing types.

# [Carvana stock plunges after profit miss vague outlook](https://substack.com/redirect/69db4f06-5a21-4284-a02a-6519e1f1f986?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Carvana shares **[tumbled as much as 20% after hours](https://substack.com/redirect/69db4f06-5a21-4284-a02a-6519e1f1f986?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** before rebounding slightly Thursday following fourth-quarter results that beat revenue expectations but missed on adjusted EBITDA due to higher reconditioning costs, while the company offered only vague guidance for 2026 growth without specific Q1 numbers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69db4f06-5a21-4284-a02a-6519e1f1f986?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Profit Metric Misses Estimates:** Adjusted EBITDA came in at $511 million versus $535.7 million expected with a 10.1% margin short of 10.4% forecast amid elevated vehicle reconditioning expenses.
* **Strong Sales Growth Reported:** Revenue surged 58% year-over-year to $5.60 billion beating estimates while retail units sold rose to 163,522 exceeding projections of 157,226.
* **Higher Costs Pressure Margins:** Reconditioning expenses increased in Q4 and are expected to remain elevated into Q1 though gross profit per unit is anticipated to rise sequentially.
* **Optimistic Yet Vague 2026 Outlook:** Company forecasts significant full-year growth in units and EBITDA with sequential Q1 gains assuming stable conditions but provided no detailed Q1 guidance disappointing investors.

# [Walmart lures wealthy shoppers, fuels massive growth](https://substack.com/redirect/28f5eed2-6d7e-4922-87a6-269efb7e3395?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Walmart reported[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/28f5eed2-6d7e-4922-87a6-269efb7e3395?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[strong Q4 results Thursday with $190.7 billion in revenue](https://substack.com/redirect/28f5eed2-6d7e-4922-87a6-269efb7e3395?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** up 5.6% as higher-income households drove gains across categories, pushing U.S. e-commerce to a record 23% of sales amid resilient value-focused consumers.
* **Higher-Income Surge Drives Gains** : The majority of market share increases came from households earning over $100,000, with Walmart's pricing and convenience resonating broadly across income tiers.
* **E-Commerce Hits Record Milestone** : Global online sales climbed 24% with U.S. e-commerce surging 27%, now representing 23% of total sales, boosted by 50% growth in store-fulfilled delivery.
* **Profits Outpace Revenue Rise** : Adjusted operating income grew faster than sales at around 10.5% (constant currency), fueled by strong advertising up 37% and membership fees rising over 15%.
* **Optimistic Yet Cautious Outlook** : Walmart forecasts 3.5% to 4.5% net sales growth for the current fiscal year with operating profit up 6% to 8%, reflecting steady consumer resilience despite economic pressures.

# [United Airlines rewards cardholders in rewards overhaul](https://substack.com/redirect/225e328a-b308-4db6-96e9-18269d9f2aae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
United Airlines overhauled its MileagePlus program Thursday, slashing mile earnings and redemption perks for non-credit cardholders while **[boosting rewards for those with co-branded cards,](https://substack.com/redirect/225e328a-b308-4db6-96e9-18269d9f2aae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** effective April 2.
* **Mile Earning Slashed** : Non-cardholders drop to 3 miles per dollar on United flights from 5, with no miles on basic economy unless elite status applies.
* **Cardholder Boosts** : Primary cardholders earn up to 6 miles per dollar or more when paying with the card, reaching 17 miles for top elites using premium cards.
* **Redemption Discounts** : Cardholders gain at least 10% off award tickets (15% for elites), plus exclusive access to low-priced Saver Awards including Polaris business class.
* **Loyalty Push** : Changes reward high-spending customers and aim to make United cards "top of wallet" amid fierce competition in travel rewards.

Noncitizen voting is already illegal under federal law. Multiple investigations and fact-checks have repeatedly confirmed it is exceedingly rare. Election officials from both parties acknowledge there is no evidence of widespread noncitizen voting . Yet extremists continue to push this lie as a pretext to flood polling places with immigration agents.

Voter ID to stop fraud before it starts 2. Paper ballots to verify every vote 3. Same-day voting to keep the process secure 4. Proof of citizenship to protect the integrity of every election These aren’t radical or partisan ideas. They’re simple, commonsense protections that are standard practice in developed democracies worldwide. Now more than ever, securing our elections must be Congress’s top priority. Our majority, the integrity of our democracy, and President Trump’s America First agenda ALL DEPEND on delivering on this urgent voter ID mandate. Peter, we’re begging you: integrity of every future election cycle rests in the hands of Patriots who are unwilling to compromise on the fundamental principles of our Republic. Together, we put a stop to a massive cash infusion that would have been used to terrorize more families, fuel more violence, and separate more children from their families. We raised our voices, flooded the phones, organized our neighbors, _and made it impossible for our communities to be ignored._ **But this fight isn’t over.** Hundreds of hardworking people came together to make this happen. _Now_ is the time to grow our movement and tap into our people-power to continue demanding permanent protections, a pathway to citizenship, and an end to funding systems that profit from our pain for our immigrant friends, family, and neighbors. **** [**The power of our collective voice is helping to protect the lives of our loved ones. ### Peter —
As we read the news and see Americans concerned about the costs imposed on them by tariffs, Presidential and Congressional approval ratings exploring new lows, continuously swirling questions about accountability and association with Jeffrey Epstein among U.S. officials, and more, we are reminded of our roots. Why does Forward exist? Forward Party was born of the simple but profound idea that what ails our competitive American democracy is "lack thereof": competition. Real, healthy competition. The current political system rewards division, stifles competition, and has literally devolved into one-party rule in several states. It is a system meant to preserve power and status quo, not one meant to lead Americans into and solve the problems of the future. Americans want a system that hears them. Hearing implies active listening. Care. Concern. A genuine desire to touch the lives of many in a positive, intentional manner. To do this, a certain type of candidate--a certain type of person--must be able to win elections. This requires a system that draws people of high integrity into politics and builds electoral systems that allow them to fairly compete and win on the basis of their accomplishments and merits. This is what we at Forward, with your help, seek to build. And we are. You are. This is an election year and a very critical one. (As they all are, really.) We encourage you to be engaged, involved, and informed. We encourage you contact your elected leadership and to vote. And we thank you for your support of our mission and ask for your continued help getting our message out. Tell your friends about us: Together, stronger. Let us build a future on the lessons of the past and present. **Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

REMINDER: The next episode of The Forward Party Podcast is now live! In Episode 3 of The Forward Party Podcast*, Gov. Christine Todd Whitman, Lt. Gov. Kerry Healey, and Lindsey Williams Drath take a wide-angle look at one of the most important shifts in American politics: the rise of independent voters and the growing demand for a new political approach. Joined by veteran political journalist Chris Cillizza and professor and historian Dr. Jeremi Suri, the conversation explores what this moment means for the future of democracy and whether a new party can move the country forward. With nearly half of Americans now identifying as independent, the hosts dig into what that really signals. Is it frustration with polarization? A rejection of party loyalty? Or a deeper desire for common-sense solutions that neither major party seems willing to prioritize? Chris Cillizza offers an unfiltered look at today’s political climate, arguing that while the appetite for change is real, building a successful third party requires more than a headline-grabbing announcement. It takes grassroots organizing, credible candidates, and proof that independent leaders can win and govern. Dr. Jeremi Suri, chair of Leadership in Global Affairs at the University of Texas at Austin, places this political moment in context. He draws parallels to the 1850's and the Progressive Era, times when economic upheaval and social change disrupted existing party systems and opened space for new movements. According to Dr. Suri, when major parties fail to address pressing concerns, voters eventually realign around leaders and ideas that better reflect their lived realities. Together, the guests explore how today’s transformations, from artificial intelligence and workforce disruption to health care affordability and political disengagement, are reshaping expectations of government. The conversation challenges the idea that Americans are divided on everything. In reality, there is broad agreement on many core issues, but the current system amplifies the smallest points of conflict. We hope you enjoy! | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

clean_body: One day a week. A radical act of trust.| | | | | Fellow Patriot, | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. - Fellow Patriot, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Fellow Patriot, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

clean_body: 9 PM Deadline| | | | | Dear Friend, Please accept your with my sincere thanks and appreciation. | | | | | | As we head into this year’s critical election, I am asking for your help in what political observers are calling one of the most targeted congressional races in the entire country. Winning a congressional race is never easy, especially onethis competitive, but with the strength, commitment, generosity,and trust of friends like you, I know we can win again this November. Control of the U.S. House once again hangs by a razor-thin margin, and national Democrats are pouring unprecedented resources into this race. Radical Democrats and outside groups see NJ-07 as a top takeover opportunity—and they are already mobilizing. Their House Majority PAC alone raised $121 million , with significant spending aimed directly at our district. We must act now to keep this seat in conservative, common-sense hands, and that means building a robust grassroots organization and preparing for our toughest fight yet. We have seen what strong, conservative leadership delivers: a stronger economy, lower taxes, American energy independence, a secure border, and an agenda that puts families and workers ahead of Washington insiders. I believe our schools should focus on academic excellence —reading, writing, math—and preparing our children for success, while respecting parents’ rights and keeping them informed. I believe in standing with law enforcement , securing our borders, and restoring accountability in government. And I believe New Jersey families deserve relief from rising costs, reckless spending, and policies that make life less affordable. That is the leadership I believe in—and the leadership I bring every day as your Congressman from New Jersey. That is why I am fighting to keep our communities safe, our economy strong, and our values protected. Friend, we need your help to continue this work. | | | | My friend, we would not hold this seat in the U.S. House of Representatives without your support. It truly means the world to me, and I am deeply grateful. I am asking you to stand shoulder to shoulder with me in what could be our toughest fight yet. Your vote, your voice, and your activism make a real difference, not just for me, but for the future of New Jersey and our country. Thank you for standing with me. | Good afternoon Friend,
**Energy is the lifeblood of the economy.** When energy is affordable and reliable, businesses expand, families thrive, and innovation flourishes. When it is unstable or overly constrained, economic growth slows and costs rise. On **Thursday, March 19****, at the Country Club of Jackson** , the Mississippi Center for Public Policy will host internationally recognized author and energy expert **Matt Ridley** for a special luncheon focused on the role energy plays in economic prosperity. Mr. Ridley is a bestselling author and respected commentator on innovation, markets, and growth. He has written extensively on energy policy, technological advancement, and the importance of reliable power in sustaining modern economies. A close friend of **United States Secretary of Energy** **Chris Wright** , Ridley has been an influential voice in discussions surrounding innovation-driven energy solutions.

Colorado firm Zynex forfeits nearly $100M as former executives face federal charges
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Denver Mayor Mike Johnston is [defending sanctuary policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as federal lawsuits advance, while Gov. Jared Polis is seeking answers after [Colorado’s largest publicly traded company announced a move to Florida](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), raising business climate concerns. A Denver homeowner’s backyard upgrade has [sparked a costly zoning dispute](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and Polis appointed Judge Susan Blanco to the [state Supreme Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, medical device firm Zynex agreed to [forfeit nearly $100 million over alleged improper billing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as former executives face federal charges.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Nationally, a coalition is asking the U.S. Supreme Court to review a Washington law that [allows runaway minors to receive gender-related medical treatments without parental notification](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), arguing lower courts have avoided key constitutional questions about parental rights. In Georgia, a veteran pollster contends that [questions surrounding the state’s 2020 voter rolls were never fully resolved](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and says access to complete data could clarify lingering concerns.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Today’s commentaries tackle faith, culture, and policy. Pastor Bob Babcox argues that [sitting out elections isn’t neutra](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)l. Another calls for a [return to civil discourse amid rising political hostility](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) following Charlie Kirk’s assassination. And Cory Gaines warns that policymakers can’t “out wish physics” when it comes to [electric school buses running well during Colorado winters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, February 19, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado firm Zynex forfeits nearly $100M as former executives face federal charges](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
An Englewood medical device company has agreed to pay millions and walk away from nearly 100 million dollars in unpaid claims after a federal investigation into its TRICARE billing practices.
This week, the U.S. Department of Justice announced that Zynex, Inc. entered into a criminal Non-Prosecution Agreement. Prosecutors said the company submitted claims for medical supplies “in quantities that exceeded physician orders” and, in some instances, were “not medically necessary.”
At the same time, a federal grand jury indictment charging former CEO Thomas Sandgaard and former Chief Operating Officer Anna Lucsok was unsealed.
The company secured a deal. Its former executives now face criminal charges in federal court.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[God, government and the ballot: Why sitting out is not neutral](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY REV. ROBERT BABCOX, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* ******Voting is a biblical responsibility — not a neutral option:** Citing Romans 13 and Proverbs, the author argues that governing authority is established by God, and ignoring the right to vote is, in effect, neglecting a God-given duty.

* **Christians should evaluate candidates through Scripture and the Constitution:** The piece urges believers to prayerfully examine how candidates live, vote, and legislate, measuring both people and policies against God’s Word and America’s founding documents.

* **Policy decisions shape moral culture — and sitting out empowers the wicked:** Drawing from Proverbs and 1 Timothy, the commentary warns that when the righteous disengage, immoral policies advance, arguing that cultural decline follows when Christians fail to steward their civic influence.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

---
**[After Charlie Kirk’s assassination: Can America reclaim civil discourse?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MADDOX SKROCKE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Political violence signals a dangerous cultural breaking point:** Following the assassination of Charlie Kirk, the commentary argues America’s deep polarization and erosion of trust have created fertile ground for radicalization and ideologically driven attacks.
* **Misinformation and outrage politics are fueling extremism:** The piece warns that distorted narratives, emotionally charged media framing, and leaders who reward outrage over reason are accelerating division and normalizing hostility in public life.
* **Civil discourse rooted in principle—not emotion—is the path forward:** The author calls on Americans to defend free speech, reject violence, and rebuild trust through principled, faith-informed dialogue modeled by Charlie Kirk’s commitment to debate without intimidation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Speech or statute? Appeals court weighs bond denial in Tina Peters case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | FEBRUARY 17** _The Colorado Court of Appeals is being asked to decide whether Tina Peters was denied bond because of her speech—or whether the issue is already foreclosed by appellate rules. Was her bond denied because of her speech?_
**[America’s real election crisis: A collapse of public trust](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN JOONDEPH | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 17** _One of the most corrosive realities in contemporary American electoral politics isn’t polarization, misinformation, or even foreign interference. It is something more basic: a majority of Americans no longer trust the integrity of their elections._
**[Two courts, one case: Judge to weigh prosecutor removal and child hearsay in Hawkins proceedings](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | FEBRUARY 17** _What began as criminal charges against retired Aurora Police Department sergeant Michael Hawkins has expanded into a dispute spanning two counties and two courts. While Hawkins faces felony allegations involving children, his former wife, Rachel Pickrel-Hawkins, was jailed after declining to follow a reunification therapy order issued during divorce proceedings._
__

Colorado accounts for nearly 15% of the 232-member 2026 U.S. team.

| | | | _[Click here if you wish to unsubscribe](https://link.victory.nancyforalaska.com/click/e39565/VaHR0cHM6Ly9uZGcubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3N1YnNjcmlwdGlvbnMvdW5zdWJzY3JpYmU/SdmljdG9yeV9uYW5jeWZvcmFsYXNrYV9jb20yNjAyMTk/LbmNseHFxVXg/qP2hpZHM9bmNOeXlVbml4WGxz/gaZdsvg/s3ldefa099e)_

| | Dear Peter, I’d like to have an honest conversation with you about Alaska.
I believe our future is bright and our best days are ahead of us as a state and country. **That’s why I decided to run to be Alaska's next governor.**
As lieutenant governor, I’ve fought tough battles for Alaskans. As Commissioner of Corrections, I fought to repeal soft-on-crime laws _and won_. And in the state legislature, I went up against politicians in Juneau to protect the PFD _and won_.
I promise to bring the same grit and common sense to the Governor’s office, because I want to ensure Alaska remains the best place to live, work, and raise a family for our kids and grandkids.
If that’s enough for you, please join my ** _[leadership team](https://link.victory.nancyforalaska.)_** by supporting me [**here**](https://link.victory.nancyforalaska.). If you’d like to read more of my story, check it out below.
---
[](https://link.victory.nancyforalaska.)
[<< JOIN THE LEADERSHIP TEAM >>](https://link.victory.nancyforalaska.)
**↓** My Alaska story starts at 18. I came up for a two-week summer trip and ended up staying to work on a pipeline.
I loved the attitude here. It was rugged, independent, full of American spirit, neighborly, and welcoming. Every day was a new adventure, so I decided to stay and build a life, career, and family here.
After working in several different industries, I was encouraged to run for office by my community. From serving nine years in the Legislature to stepping up as Commissioner of Corrections and now as your Lieutenant Governor, I’ve always kept my word and put Alaskans first above party politics and political pressure.
_**That’s how you have to lead in Alaska:
with grit and the resolve to do the right thing.**_
_As governor, I’ll focus on what matters most:_
* _**Protecting**_ the PFD for families today and tomorrow
* Growing jobs and _**strengthening**_ our economy
* Supporting resource development to _**lower costs**_ and achieve energy independence
* Backing law enforcement and _**keeping our communities safe**_
* Balancing budgets and _**cutting waste**_
* Building _**strong schools**_ and preparing students for the future.

Alaska gave me everything, and I vow to continue giving back.
Now that you know my story, I hope to hear yours over the next year. Today, I am hopeful that you will take two minutes to become a part of our [**leadership team**](https://link.victory.nancyforalaska.) with a small or large financial contribution. Whatever fits your budget!
I’d be honored to have your support. Together, we will build a stronger future for Alaska.
With gratitude,
**Nancy Dahlstrom**
_Alaska's Lt. Governor
Law Enforcement Leader_
_2026 Republican Candidate for Governor_
[DONATE TODAY LET'S STRENGTHEN ALASKA](https://link.victory.nancyforalaska.)

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: This is a cover-up.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Let’s call a spade a spade: Pam Bondi doesn’t care one bit about the Epstein victims, and the DOJ is orchestrating a clear cover-up of Epstein’s (and all his co-conspirators’ and enablers’) crimes.
Last week, during a House Judiciary Committee hearing on the Epstein files, Bondi couldn’t even bring herself to look at the survivors sitting right behind her.
And now we know that the DOJ hasn’t even listened to many of the survivors, despite their efforts to give victim testimony and critical information. When my colleague asked the survivors in the room to stand and raise their hands if they had been ignored by the Justice Department, every single one of them did .
That alone tells you everything you need to know about Pam Bondi’s Department of Justice.
And it only got worse from there. The Attorney General’s behavior throughout the hearing was completely unhinged — taunting members of Congress, shouting, finger-pointing, name-calling.
But what’s truly damning is how she has handled this investigation from the start — without the seriousness, respect, and gravity the survivors deserve. Her DOJ has fought the release of these documents every step of the way, only dropping batches incrementally because they’ve been legally compelled to.
And it’s come out that she’s even surveilling Members of Congress when they’re viewing the unredacted version of the Epstein Files.
Throughout this process, these documents have been heavily and unnecessarily redacted to shield Epstein’s powerful alleged clients and friends, while failing to protect the identities and privacy of victims and survivors.
That’s the truth about Pam Bondi and her DOJ: they're far more concerned with protecting powerful people perpetrating disgusting abuse than protecting Americans from harm.
For his part, President Trump says we should all move on from the Epstein files. Of course, he’s referenced in them himself more than 38,000 times (and that’s just in the redacted versions 😬).
This isn’t just incompetence — it’s a cover-up, and we can’t let it continue.
This November, we can flip the House and force transparency, conduct real oversight, and make sure no one is above the law.
To do all that, we need to put in the work now. If you’re in a position to donate, will you contribute today and help our work to flip the House blue in less than nine months? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=25]

DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=50]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
Justice doesn’t happen by accident. It happens when people refuse to look away — and when we do the work to put accountability back where it belongs.
Thank you for standing with me in this fight.
—Sara

| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch just scored a **big win** for government transparency, thanks to the generous support of our donors.
The Department of Justice (DOJ) has publicly acknowledged an ongoing _criminal investigation_ related to the taxpayer-funded **U.S. African Development Foundation**(USADF).
_Why is that a win for Judicial Watch?_
_Our lawsuit_ prompted the disclosure.
Last year, _we sued_ USADF for records on its expenditures and deposits as a response to credible allegations of **waste, fraud, and abuse** committed by senior officials, contractors, and grantees.
| [ CLICK HERE TO EXPOSE MORE CORRUPTION ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79749&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

This Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) suite also asked for documents regarding retaliation against whistleblowers and the agency's attempt to block Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) audits.

Our whistleblower tipoffs came from **Judicial Watch** clients Jasmine Battle and Mateo Dunne, themselves former senior officials at USADF who faced retaliation when they tried to use every legal means to expose the corruption they saw.

Fortunately, _thanks to our FOIA litigation_ , the Department of Justice has now pledged to **immediately begin producing documents** related to their credible allegations.

That matters because _the documents are the truth_.

**American taxpayers like you deserve the truth about how their tax dollars are being misused.** And the brave whistleblowers deserve justice.

Helping whistleblowers fight for justice against government corruption with our FOIA lawsuits is just one way **the generous support of Judicial Watch donors helps us force government transparency**. _[Will you join them today by making a generous first-time gift](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79749&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_?

[ FUEL OUR FIGHT AGAINST WASTE, FRAUD, & ABUSE ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79749&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**Your support matters because government corruption isn 't abstract. **

* It abuses your tax dollars
* It punishes citizen truth-tellers
* It protects and entrenches The Deep State

Our team works hard to make wins like this one possible.

_But, they do not come easy, or cheap_.

These victories require years of legal work, constant pressure, and resources to outlast the stonewalling of federal agencies with essentially limitless legal budgets.

_[That's why I'm asking you today to make a gift to help Judicial Watch keep the pressure on the Deep State.
[ FIGHT BACK AGAINST GOVERNMENT ABUSE ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79749&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Thank you for considering support for Judicial Watch. Let's keep pressing forward together.
Sincerely,
Tom Fitton
President, Judicial Watch

#
Did you see what JD Vance said about Alexandria? He said she’s “somebody who doesn't know what she actually thinks.”
**JD Vance is wrong**. Here’s what Alexandria thinks:
* In the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, when a person gets sick, they shouldn’t go bankrupt.
* A minimum wage should cover the minimum cost to live.
* Homes are not slot machines for investors and Wall Street to extort working families out of every last dollar that they have.

body:
Truth is...it’s pretty simple.
Peter, people ask me all the time what the "special sauce" is to winning three statewide elections in a deep-red state that Trump won by over 30 points.

_How do you serve as a Democratic governor in a place where the political math isn't supposed to add up?_ I talked about this on _The Daily Show_ recently, and the answer isn't complicated. But before I go any further, [**can I count on you to chip in any amount you can to help me move our work to elect common sense leaders to office forward?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125729984/602721993/1338299492?refcode=em26_260219_ssauce_fndd_gq_act___GOVAB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260219_ssauce_fndd_gq_act___GOVAB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=2c08d4f8-d40d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmMwOGQ0ZjgtZDQwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wP9nuFGeEmBsmvKzvIVsbq3mqByOzBpE2jDEiR8uMTM=)

**First, you follow your values.** You stand up for your convictions, and you stand up for the values of the people you represent. You focus on the issues that matter most in their daily lives — good jobs, strong public schools, safe communities, and affordable healthcare. When you keep your attention there, you can actually move your state forward.

**Second, Democrats need to get back to talking like normal people.** We don't need more buzzwords. We don't need to spin someone's crisis into a phrase that sounds clever in Washington. We need to meet people where they are, listen to what they're going through, and speak plainly about what we're going to do to help. No one wants to feel talked down to, and no one wants to feel like a political talking point.

**And third, we have to talk more about our "why."** Democrats are good at explaining the policies they support. But we need to work on explaining why we are fighting for this policy. Why does this decision matter? Why will it make your life better? Leadership isn't about the spotlight. It isn't about building power for yourself. It's about keeping your focus where it belongs — on the people you serve. Always.

That's the kind of leadership we're working to build across the country through In This Together PAC. Leaders who stay grounded in their communities, speak plainly, and always remember that public service is about improving lives, _not winning arguments._

_The truth is:_ **There's really no secret formula, just integrity, compassion, and dedication to doing the job you were hired to do as a public servant.**

_That's it._

body:
[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260219-61188&t=1001&akid=61188%2E1407376%2E04666o ]Demand Justice PAC[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260219-61188&t=1002&akid=61188%2E1407376%2E04666o ]Demand Justice PAC

If you
think the story of the courts starts and ends at the Supreme Court, you’re
missing the real takeover.

Authoritarianism doesn’t arrive all at once. It seeps in — quietly,
strategically — through the lower courts.

District courts. Courts of appeals.

These are the judges who decide whether someone can access abortion care.
Whether a voter gets to cast a ballot. Whether a worker can sue for
discrimination. Whether a family can stay together. Whether corporate
polluters get a free pass.

They make the vast majority of decisions. And for most people, their
ruling is final.

And here’s what’s even more alarming: the lower courts are the farm team

Hi Friend. It’s Jane Fonda — yes, that Jane Fonda, who’s been arrested more than once for standing up for what’s right.
When I founded the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, it was with one mission in mind: to help elect bold leaders who aren’t afraid to take on the fossil fuel industry and fight for our future.
That’s exactly why we’re endorsing Heidi Hall for Congress, and why I ’m personally asking you to help elect her as the next representative of California’s 3rd Congressional District.
Let me explain.
Heidi has spent her life taking on powerful interests — and winning for everyday people.
As a Nevada County Supervisor for the past nine years, she made climate resilience a top priority, helping secure real resources to address the impacts of climate change on the ground. She didn’t just support the policy; she led the effort to adopt it.
But what makes Heidi the type of candidate that gets me excited is that her love for our planet translates directly into her love for people:
Heidi is calling for Kristi Noem’s impeachment, for abolishing ICE, and for prosecuting ICE agents who have brought terror into our communities.
That’s what leadership looks like, Friend — and boy do we need more leaders like her in Washington right now standing up to the horrors of the Trump Administration.
So can you join me in supporting Heidi’s campaign by making your very own donation right now? I want to send a powerful message to everyone watching that people are on our side. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20260219_em_fr_b1_JFCP_BIG]

We don’t have time for half-measures or delay. We need to elect courageous leaders who have the grit and backbone to take on Donald Trump, Big Oil, and corporate corruption — and are ready to act. Heidi is that kind of leader. Let’s help get her elected.
In solidarity,
Jane Fonda
Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

They include the Arizona Senate, Arizona House, Maine House, Michigan House, Michigan Senate, Minnesota Senate, Minnesota House, New Hampshire House, Pennsylvania House, Wisconsin Senate, and the Wisconsin House. Control of these chambers could come down to just a handful of seats – and with them, the future of fundamental freedoms in these states. = | = States are a crucial line of defense against the chaos coming out of Washington. It’s state legislatures that determine whether Republicans can secure power through gerrymandering, whether our health care is cut, whether voting rights are safeguarded, and whether abortion protections are defended and restored. That’s why EMILYs List is going all-in on these battleground states through our State Power Plan. This is the largest single-cycle investment in state and local races in our more than 40-year history – because we know how critical this moment is. We’re using our organizational expertise to recruit strong candidates, build strategic, winning campaigns, and position women leaders to make an immediate impact and build for future cycles. We partner with state and local candidates from day one — often before they even announce their campaigns. We help recruit them, support them as they grow and scale, and stand with them every step of the way to overcome whatever challenges come their way. name: Team Cooper
subject: Clean energy?
body:
It’s their dirty little secret.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=607%2E124072%2E7RQFfn)
**[Can we ask you about clean energy, Peter? If you support expanding clean energy options, add your name right now.](https://act.roycooper.com/signup/clean-energy/?source=em_RC_PET_cleanenergy_021926&t=7&akid=607%2E124072%2E7RQFfn)** As Governor of North Carolina, Roy Cooper helped build a thriving clean energy economy. **It’s something that _just makes sense_ — more energy options bring costs down for families and help protect our planet for the future.** Meanwhile, expanding clean energy business opportunities led to creating even more good-paying jobs for North Carolinians. Peter, so many far-right Republicans seem to have it out for clean energy, and we can’t help but think Big Oil money might have something to do with it. GOP candidates count on massive checks from Big Oil to fund their campaigns — our Trump-picked opponent even worked as an oil lobbyist in DC! As the next Democratic Senator from North Carolina, Roy is ready to fight to bring energy costs down and create jobs by expanding clean energy options — just like he did here in NC. He needs to know where you stand. **[Add your name now to let all of us at Cooper HQ know that YOU support clean energy>>>](https://act.roycooper.com/signup/clean-energy/?source=em_RC_PET_cleanenergy_021926&t=8&akid=607%2E124072%2E7RQFfn)** | [SIGN ON](https://act.roycooper.com/signup/clean-energy/?source=em_RC_PET_cleanenergy_021926&t=9&akid=607%2E124072%2E7RQFfn)

Team Cooper
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend,
---
I want to share something most people never see. When a child is rescued from sex trafficking, the danger may be over... but the pain is not. **Their body is free.**
But their heart, mind, and spirit are often still trapped. Many have nowhere safe to go. No bed of their own.
No warm meal waiting.
No trusted adult to say,
**" You are safe now. You are loved."** This is why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists. The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** was created after the success of the film _Sound of Freedom_ --to turn awareness into action.

Its mission is simple and urgent: **to stop the sale of God 's children** by supporting rescue, protection, and long-term healing for victims of trafficking. Every day, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** works with trusted partners to help ensure that rescued children are not forgotten.**Because rescue is not the end of a child 's story.** Children who have survived trafficking carry deep trauma--
fear, shame, confusion, and pain no child should ever know. **They need more than freedom alone.**
**They need healing.** And healing begins in a home. That is why one of the Foundation's key partners is the House Parent Project.
---
[ **Give a Child a Place To Go**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c10911006d714345b810b1e81a066079&_e=mwoJL1X7TyRbWvI18D54JbBTimmWIee-N3dC0yNwt417Tm5c8Lcyc0cPsXfczIMRcOoda5xCyHG5ApMTHwCBdAa5iT_sQY3cuLF0bNqY0CKIkGXHdGim1dFXXYBLtnMT8jOLXlEeyg5zPHelDQG_DwgNoXtI8WW9gG0IxnavDiWfWLP9XssLaRvA7wX1HHqm-8QpmqxFSNG2yr4UY5wbWwyC2mBFnq1u6GejgqoBpvhoRlEwQZcrBr53N5WdfYnzTz6GzzIY9d5ZuvFajwxLu0_3BiO_b0p165U4Oh1nmnrcFoCTGNa-vquf6bNsVALmQSdGk5CGQhL18lM_AqcofBmGDpBhr6lmRqdMtc1fQ86DPLfpDAdqPgHsW80PcrCTiAhgcZFSJL8GcPdOm2W3Ki9VcX9GqTW7MO7-3XuKSkFeORv7MLYSq-etx4mKQupPdO_bhUAC1MvxKtQAetrpLPYn0Os4HXodv7YrHkoL_y6u1KCzC57S6qKDXZahsr0pVawSf2nD_4K3s96m7IJ0E0jR1cvyMT0A0UgFapBVhIFAOJ4BosqbcfRv2e2xW5U38of3uIGWnoGHKZqoWAZ3Y6nSmubb2tQox2UTyp-bbqxQAwj4_Db4WPPUs_qi6eFNfNlmjFxD_eI6MeobYRZFSJXU82VGSk1gW2isyCTtQ2flIecVEFF8kxT8M7oi7AFyUhOHjkZQWlO1Lz8CSM8eaNtlNn87tdvqQ_2SFi3Hc7yPOUrh8QMxm46rhgXbhzSRyvD5UsZkg5EXwE_TFxrqMw%3D%3D)

The House Parent Project is a nationwide network of **trauma-informed, faith-filled homes** created specifically for children rescued from sex trafficking who have _no place to go_.

It exists to answer one heartbreaking cry heard again and again after rescues: "I have no place to go." Through this partnership, rescued children are not sent back into uncertainty.

They are welcomed into safety--into homes where healing can finally begin. In these homes, dedicated house parents provide:
---
* Immediate safe shelter
* Nutritious meals and clean clothing
* Medical and trauma-informed mental-health care
* Secure transportation and protection
* And most of all--consistent, loving adults who pray, listen, and stay

---
These house parents provide more than a roof. **They create an environment where a child can finally sleep without fear. **
**Where nightmares begin to fade. **
**Where trust is slowly rebuilt. **One little girl told us the first night she stayed in her house parent's home was the first night she had ever slept through the night. **That is what your generosity makes possible.** When you give, you are helping place a rescued child into a home of restoration. Jesus said,
_" I was a stranger, and you welcomed me."_ When you support this work, you are welcoming a child who has been rescued from evil-- and reminding them that God has not abandoned them.

clean_body: This is where healing begins. Rescue saves lives--but healing needs a home | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend, I want to share something most people never see. When a child is rescued from sex trafficking, the danger may be over... but the pain is not. Their body is free. But their heart, mind, and spirit are often still trapped. Many have nowhere safe to go. No bed of their own. No warm meal waiting. No trusted adult to say, " You are safe now. You are loved." This is why the Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. The Sound of Freedom Foundation was created after the success of the film Sound of Freedom --to turn awareness into action. Its mission is simple and urgent: to stop the sale of God 's children by supporting rescue, protection, and long-term healing for victims of trafficking. Every day, the Sound of Freedom Foundation works with trusted partners to help ensure that rescued children are not forgotten.Because rescue is not the end of a child 's story. Children who have survived trafficking carry deep trauma-- fear, shame, confusion, and pain no child should ever know. They need more than freedom alone. They need healing. And healing begins in a home. That is why one of the Foundation's key partners is the House Parent Project. The House Parent Project is a nationwide network of trauma-informed, faith-filled homes created specifically for children rescued from sex trafficking who have no place to go. It exists to answer one heartbreaking cry heard again and again after rescues: "I have no place to go." Through this partnership, rescued children are not sent back into uncertainty. They are welcomed into safety--into homes where healing can finally begin. In these homes, dedicated house parents provide: Immediate safe shelter Nutritious meals and clean clothing Medical and trauma-informed mental-health care Secure transportation and protection And most of all--consistent, loving adults who pray, listen, and stay These house parents provide more than a roof. They create an environment where a child can finally sleep without fear. Where nightmares begin to fade. Where trust is slowly rebuilt. One little girl told us the first night she stayed in her house parent's home was the first night she had ever slept through the night. That is what your generosity makes possible. When you give, you are helping place a rescued child into a home of restoration. Jesus said, " I was a stranger, and you welcomed me." When you support this work, you are welcoming a child who has been rescued from evil-- and reminding them that God has not abandoned them. One survivor's story shows why this matters so deeply. Here’s how we can achieve these freedoms right here in Colorado: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125734383/602736591/-272948131?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260219_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOWY0MzY0NS1lMTBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LdjahUxO2oDPxKQGXzZnpXg_QybJDbGhjgWXpzwal4E=&emci=56e01588-340d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=e9f43645-e10d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=252045)
