**The freedom to rise, the freedom to learn, the freedom from violence, and the freedom to govern ourselves.** I believe that every American is entitled to those four fundamental freedoms. Those values are what have guided my work in public service. Here’s how we can achieve these freedoms right here in Colorado: By ensuring Colorado families can afford healthcare, childcare, and housing; by fighting childhood poverty; and by building an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top, **_we can achieve the freedom to rise._** By modernizing our education system to set our kids up for success, no matter what zip code they are born into, and paying our educators what they deserve, **_we can achieve the freedom to learn._** By partnering with local law enforcement and communities to keep Coloradans safe, fighting the opioid epidemic, and combating the extremism that flourishes on social media, **_we can achieve freedom from violence._** By protecting Coloradans' voting rights, keeping the government out of our bedrooms and doctors' offices, and reforming our electoral system so the people, not dark money, have the most power, **_we can achieve the freedom to govern ourselves._** Achieving these goals in the political climate we are living through right now may feel impossible, but I know fighting for what is fundamental will always be worth it. _That’s why I’m running for Governor. Working together, right here at home, we can truly achieve these fundamental freedoms and provide the rest of the country with the hopeful and optimistic vision we desperately need._ [**I can’t and wouldn’t want to do this without you by our side. Will you chip in $10, split between Martin Heinrich ****and myself, to fuel this campaign and help us build a better future for us all?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125734384/602736592/-994038426?amount=10&refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260219_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOWY0MzY0NS1lMTBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LdjahUxO2oDPxKQGXzZnpXg_QybJDbGhjgWXpzwal4E=) Thank you, Michael

I believe that every American is entitled to those four fundamental freedoms. Those values are what have guided my work in public service. Here’s how we can achieve these freedoms right here in Colorado: By ensuring Colorado families can afford healthcare, childcare, and housing; by fighting childhood poverty; and by building an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top, we can achieve the freedom to rise. By modernizing our education system to set our kids up for success, no matter what zip code they are born into, and paying our educators what they deserve, we can achieve the freedom to learn. By partnering with local law enforcement and communities to keep Coloradans safe, fighting the opioid epidemic, and combating the extremism that flourishes on social media, we can achieve freedom from violence. By protecting Coloradans' voting rights, keeping the government out of our bedrooms and doctors' offices, and reforming our electoral system so the people, not dark money, have the most power, we can achieve the freedom to govern ourselves. Achieving these goals in the political climate we are living through right now may feel impossible, but I know fighting for what is fundamental will always be worth it. That’s why I’m running for Governor. Working together, right here at home, we can truly achieve these fundamental freedoms and provide the rest of the country with the hopeful and optimistic vision we desperately need. = Thank you, Michael | Paid for by Martin Heinrich for Senate Senator Martin Heinrich is committed to helping New Mexico become a leader in defense, tech, and energy with opportunities in every corner. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

body:
It’s because she’s fighting for us
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260219-2530)
Peter,
Today, Fran was featured on the cover of [TIME](https://act.francescahong.com/go/4938?t=1&akid=2530%2E105371%2EAjo0j5) magazine alongside eight other Americans from across the political spectrum who are calling for guardrails on unchecked AI expansion.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/4938?t=2&akid=2530%2E105371%2EAjo0j5)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260219.vLc-YM&amount=5&refcode=em20260219-2530&t=21&akid=2530%2E105371%2EAjo0j5)**
From the article:
> A democratic socialist, Hong has prioritized the issue of affordability for working-class people. The proliferation of data centers has become central to that conversation.
> She criticizes the tax breaks that many data centers receive to set up shop; the NDAs signed by officials that keep citizens in the dark on many details; and the failed promises of previous projects. In Mount Pleasant, Wis., the TV-manufacturing factory run by tech company Foxconn promised to create 13,000 jobs and required more than $1 billion in public spending before sputtering in value and being converted into a data center.
> With that debacle fresh in mind, campaigns to defeat proposed data centers have cropped up across the state, successfully halting projects in Caledonia and Menominee. Hong co-drafted a statewide data-center moratorium bill in February.
> “We’re focused on strong local economies where there are long-term gains and positive impact,” she says, “and we’re not seeing that from places across the country that have constructed these AI data centers.” Hong says her stance reflects the position of the state. “It’s important to see this as a democracy issue,” she says. “Folks are exercising their right to have their voices heard.”
Fran has been a leader on AI data center regulation since day one, co-authoring legislation like the Data Center Pause and Utility Rate Cap bills: common-sense protections so communities don’t get stuck with higher costs, environmental fallout, and sweetheart deals that benefit corporations more than residents.
As governor, Fran’s _Control-Alt-Delete_ plan will put real guardrails on AI data centers—so any future project guarantees real benefits for Wisconsin. That means transparency, no cost-shifting onto ratepayers, meaningful environmental safeguards, and job standards that actually raise the floor for working people.
We have a rare opportunity right now: a major national spotlight, a clear contrast, and a message that’s breaking through.
But we can’t capitalize on momentum without resources.
**[Fran is the only candidate willing to stand up to these corporations.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260219.vLc-YM&refcode=em20260219-2530&t=22&akid=2530%2E105371%2EAjo0j5)**
**[She’s going to lose out on big, fat checks from developers -- because she’s working for you.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260219.vLc-YM&refcode=em20260219-2530&t=23&akid=2530%2E105371%2EAjo0j5)**
**[We need you to step up NOW to support her.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260219.vLc-YM&refcode=em20260219-2530&t=24&akid=2530%2E105371%2EAjo0j5)**
With gratitude,
— Team Hong

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125734916/602738292/-664395954?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzFlZDFlMC1lMjBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q6cvCyL80xh5lu7xLFQkIv31hch342wP3vVMUxnptAM=)
**➤➤ URGENT: Trump weaponizes immigration to subvert our elections**
* * *
Friend, Trump and his allies are laying the groundwork to interfere with elections – again. This time, they’re using immigration as the excuse. They’re pushing the same lie over and over: that non-citizens are voting in large numbers, and that’s why elections can’t be trusted. There’s no evidence of that. _Zero._ Let’s be clear: they’re not saying it because it’s true – they’re saying it because it gives them cover to meddle in elections. Hi team,
Dan Meuser just said that the two ICE facilities coming to our area will have **" a very positive impact on my district".**
A positive impact for who, exactly?
Not for the taxpayers footing the $1 million bill. Not for the small towns that don't have the infrastructure to support thousands of people coming in. And not for anyone with the values people in our community were raised with.
I'm the daughter of a pastor and a nurse. I was taught that you look after your neighbor and treat people with dignity. These detention centers are known for doing the opposite. They have a history of abuse and inhumane conditions. _We don 't want that in our backyards._
**The people here have been voicing their concerns for months now and getting nothing but BS from their representative. Meuser trying to twist this into a win isn 't fooling anyone.**

name: David Hogg
subject: I just watched our first member of Congress get sworn in
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Christian Menefee, our first Congressional candidate of 2026, was just sworn in – and every member we’re challenging saw us there.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260219-1&t=1&akid=3165%2E587540%2EC1U5Vl)
Peter,
I just watched Christian Menefee get sworn into Congress.
_(And shockingly, Mike Johnson swore him in without any drama.)_
Christian is our _first endorsed candidate elected to Congress this cycle_ , and seeing him take that oath rewarded all of our hard work.
What was even better? When Christian turned to thank his wife, I was sitting right next to her, and **every member of Congress — including the ones we are challenging — looked up and saw us there.**
Let that moment sink in. The complacent Democrats who were sitting too comfortably in their seats looked up and saw the organization coming for them sitting right there in the chamber.
**[Will you contribute $5 to Leaders We Deserve to help us elect more fighters like Christian?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260219_1_menefee.NVlVVL&refcode=em20260219-3165&amount=5&t=2&akid=3165%2E587540%2EC1U5Vl)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260219_1_menefee.NVlVVL&amount=5&refcode=em20260219-3165&t=21&akid=3165%2E587540%2EC1U5Vl)**
This isn’t about electing younger versions of the same people already in Congress. It’s about supporting leaders like Christian who understand their constituents. Who when asked by someone like Mike Johnson if he’s going to vote to increase ICE funding, responds that he will vote in a form representative of his district and then votes no on more ICE funding.
When Texas Republicans tried to restrict voting rights and throw out election results, Christian Menefee **fought them in court and won**. When corporations polluted poor neighborhoods in his community **he forced them to clean up their mess.**
He’s the first in his family to graduate college. He’s a proud product of Texas public schools. Christian has fought against price-gouging and is using his law degree to stand up for families across the state.
_Some may talk about pushing back, but Christian built a record of real results._
Watching him get sworn in was a much-needed reminder of why we do this work. And the results that come with it. Every incumbent watching should have looked up, understanding the power that we have and _what we will do with it._
**[If you're ready to help us elect a new generation of progressive fighters, will you contribute $5 to Leaders We Deserve today?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260219_1_menefee.NVlVVL&refcode=em20260219-3165&amount=5&t=22&akid=3165%2E587540%2EC1U5Vl)**
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

I've endured relentless attacks from Trump and his MAGA supporters. They've called me every name in the book. They've threatened my family. They’ve threatened me.
**But I still believe that we must stand up for what’s right.**
_Now, Donald Trump is back in the White House with unchecked power._
His ICE agents are terrorizing communities with masks and military weapons — just like his insurrectionists did on January 6th. The only difference is that now they're being paid with your tax dollars.
His MAGA enablers in Congress are letting him treat the Constitution like it's optional. They're ignoring subpoenas. They're refusing oversight. They're acting like Trump is a king instead of a president.
And I'm not going to sit back and let it happen.
_**That's why I'm running for Congress, Peter.**_
Because my oath to protect and defend the Constitution didn't end on January 6th. It will never end.

Iran War Drums Beat Louder

The clock is ticking on diplomacy with Iran. After two days of stalled nuclear talks in Geneva, the Pentagon is now [repositioning personnel](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LGOtSAQBeCnwU4DI2osKP6G7v7tlmaE4ToJgkGu7uNv3EfY7jTnfMn5ei0v5Mjp_R93Mu7ixWe_1PLZj0RYOL09OT45p8o75QUkjK2EVs1LiotqvHF-7KEho6ZJDVpp3Teb8UqhHCcncZUDjSoE3RP23k3r2sNADZtnSYKaAQapVSdnGbwcpwHCOoeghJafw2Ols3M5nVQurHwRp5SflFPn8t5Es9V6nKL_J8AKsAU95y7k70T3U9wF2AcSYCUIsGoWYPlsbyztzXVruWBqOdHFFddIAmxTjD9ujpHPcRJavnfk-IvVP_xzGfgJAAD__-Ibc-Q) and surging weaponry — warships, air defenses, submarines — to the Middle East ahead of a possible strike. A second aircraft carrier group is en route to the region. Trump has told the world Iran would be [very wise](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGunTAQRL8GOiN7MSAKF2noXtqUyM-75q5k1sj4QvL3EfcTXjfNzOicP1_rl-fEsv32O7lw8YoZ11re-yHkC8uGFPjkLJV3yitoGJUGZeZV0mpadAHHHlpyZprMYI21fftyNIyxRwLoxxi8tyF8RxsHT2EaMUyhZfcsaTAzwKCt6fSsI-pxGiB-zzGaxur3gb7S2YUsJ5XLV76IRfKTsnQh721yr1qPs-l_NbA0sNz33cX8V-h-ansDSz5YOEsDy56LsGxqS7n8U_fLV3UUOhlJqsIsPqH6gKsHGUlhVly8tMXhcXNKfI5TY_W2e06f9_oDYZeD_wEAAP__xdx-1g) to take his deal, while press secretary Karoline Leavitt said flat-out there are "many reasons" to strike. The Iranian foreign minister is digging in — missiles are [non-negotiable](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHO4yAQhJ_G7rBgjU1cUFyT7r_2SmsD62QVDBYQo7z9KXmEv5tiNKPv-_ez_iAHjve_uJN1J68--bXm135Ewszx7slx4RQr75RWkDALCUItawyr6r11fh6hJ6uMUZNWWo_9wyq6wayWTV8MTsZt82QuXntNuIEGfenZfpYkqAVgkloNcpGbl7OZYLst26Y6LV-Hx0plcCkWyidWPoljTJ-U4uDS3gf7qPUo3fing2sH19baEKmVRvT8FDq4flkEZ4yiYRY7B66Y36LUzE8qIr5cIMzCEwbh-QhpR_cWSk16NJPus_VH4xC4zKbT8r4jh-93_YWu08L_AAAA___vgHt7), Tehran says. Vance told Fox News the Iranians have not yet acknowledged the president's red lines, adding Trump has "a lot of tools." Decision time could come as early as this weekend. Tehran is buying time, and Trump isn't blinking. ★★★
Board of Peace Holds Opening Meeting

President Trump convened the inaugural meeting of the Board of Peace at the newly renamed Donald J. Trump U.S. Institute of Peace on Thursday morning, with [representatives from over 45 nations](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGutCAUhJ8GOjZwFmQtKP7Gbv_2lgbhqCdBMIrs69-4j3C7SSaZyff9vMe3p0R5-e83dKHRGEsc63Fte0Z_UF4iBjqp5EoblhEkdEKCUP2Y06h4dCF2T-DolLXKaKX1k6_OG6vx1elggzQSrdJd35vJGGsAYJKc3L0kQfUARmr1kL2co-ysgXnq51kxLa89-ornI5R84tF8pYaUc7lTyY9QNp7cWut-suc_BgODoa64Ukp3x2BoFLGIkGg_GQzGav0CIz6-hlUkaii-nIKyv5br8ElMxR9RlFns6AOKDbFSXhgM_HBx_1BKdHaWablsnr4vvP5BWnPwGwAA__88FHu5) in attendance. Trump announced the U.S. will contribute [$10 billion](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDHO3CAUhE8DHSt4i8EUFGncbdqUFoaH_SQMls06yu2j3SP83Uij-aT5_rzmV6BCdf0ddvTxpjm1NPfzvR8Vw0l1TRjpolY77dhmkGCEBKHcXMusePIxmSdw9MpaNWil9ZNvPhq1jIijM1lGqQ2MVo8qpLRo5WAJnPyHJEE5gEFq9ZBO5iSNHSAvLmfFtHwfKXS8HrHVC887dLqRam2f1Oojtp0Xv_V-XOz5i8HEYOobblTKp2MwHa1Q_MdgotrxrN9ZKAymweoBnBXfnyK_a6K6iqWFM4mWxYEhIoOJnz4df6kUuoxlWq57oC-b9x-ouj38DwAA__9g03jb) to the reconstruction effort, with member states pledging another $7 billion and committing thousands of troops to the international stabilization force. A plan for 100,000 homes for 500,000 residents is already on the table. France, Germany, and the UK sat it out, but 45 nations showed up. Trump's Gaza vision is taking real shape. ★★★
NYU Langone Folds on Trans Kids

One of New York's most prestigious hospital systems has officially shuttered its [Transgender Youth Health Program](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2u3CAURldjd1iA_4aCIo27SZvSwnDxXAUuCBg72f3TvCW87mu-c6Tz57k_DQak87eJoO2Fu0tub-UdM4EpSKcDixUTNYyQdsnlwrhkQu0UdtE7bd0yyh60WFcxT2Kaxv6ljxlgFHx1djoe7qGUN4ddnJn94UeuTI_6Q-JSKClnPomBK-4dX9ZZ-kN5L7qJv7MzDepgE1Uol2l4ARKlz0o02BT7oF-t5dqNvzq5dXK773vw6R_B_bnFTm7v2smtpcwIbvY_lb_slWrGZgIDcqwVQ_UEclBYLuksJrKIlErti3b5xhCwLms38TMaDN_S9oNOl5ZfAQAA___ojXs1), ending hormone therapies, puberty blockers, and surgical interventions for minors. # [February is Black History Month](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=188544387&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg4NTQ0Mzg3LCJpYXQiOjE3NzE1NDE2NDYsImV4cCI6MTc3NDEzMzY0NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.QNqjkh1YhvAy1UgRWW0qi_2A-kA5UdD9h-ixVhxOOEo)
### But the work to build a better country for all doesn't start or end here.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Feb 19
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL2ZlYnJ1YXJ5LWlzLWJsYWNrLWhpc3RvcnktbW9udGg_.lWfouoTiffSqjseMrQt43_uu8Ahcw8zDiKzhvfg-uyY?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/february-is-black-history-month?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
February is Black History Month. And as Trump and the MAGA GOP attempt to erase and minimize the importance of this month, it is more crucial than ever that we take time to recognize the trailblazers who came before us, reflect on how far we've come, and look towards the work that still lies ahead.
The work of tackling racism and ensuring the truth of _liberty and justice for all_ goes far beyond one month of the year. This is work we must all be engaged with all 365 days a year.
That's why I've made showing up for Black communities in Michigan a key part of my life's work and of this campaign -- not for a photo op, not to win votes on Election Day, but to send a clear message about how -- and _for_ _whom_ -- I will show up as a leader in the U.S. Senate.
I've spoken with Black constituents all over the state, met with faith leaders from Black congregations, and been honored to receive endorsements from Black community leaders in Michigan like Lavora Barnes, the former Chair of the Michigan Democratic Party, and Joe Tate, the former Speaker of the MI House and the first Black speaker of the MI House.
Throughout these conversations, I've been listening to folks' concerns, fears, and frustrations with Trump and the GOP-led Congress. I've connected with people over our shared values and hopes for our country's future. **And I 'm more aware than ever of the need for a vision of America that prioritizes the needs of underserved communities in Michigan** -- Black communities, working-class communities, communities that have too long been left behind by mainstream politics.
All of us, whether Black, brown, or white, have a responsibility to carry on the legacy of the leaders who came before us. Those who had the courage to dream of a better America and then take to the streets, courthouses, and halls of Congress to fight for it.
That's exactly what this campaign is about. It's about imagining a better future -- a better country -- and then putting in the work to bring that vision to life.
**Because all of us, regardless of identity or background, deserve dignity, opportunity, and a fair shot. That 's what Black History Month reminds us of, and that's why I'm running to be Michigan's next senator.**
With grit, gratitude, hope, and determination,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

I delivered the State of the District last week.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125736336/602742997/-153530995?refcode=EM_F_260219state_N_SB_90DO_5_NG_N__LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NTg3MjZiNy1lNjBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x8iXj0b8P3K6rPY1f-69jUOQa3c_ynqkIRUwKIds9KU=) Peter,

Last week, I delivered the State of Ohio’s 11th Congressional District Address to outline the harm that Trump and his backward administration have inflicted on Northeast Ohio, celebrate our values, and issue a call to action for us to stick together. This speech came ahead of what will surely be a ludicrous State of the Union speech by Trump next week.

I highlighted that, despite being in the minority in the House, we have secured $12 million in funding for local projects this year and have defeated Trump’s attempts to cut grant funding and close the Cleveland Job Corps.

Additionally, as I said on Thursday, the State of Northeast Ohio is resilient, compassionate, and defiant. While we have been hit by all sides by a White House that is stripping away health care and food benefits, and who are defunding schools, terrorizing our communities with ICE, and stretching our pocketbooks thin with reckless tariffs, we have a message: **we will not stand still, and we will not back down.**

**Throughout the chaos of 2025, we have banded together and worked to support one another. We’ve been tested, but not defeated. Bent, but not broken. We know our strength, and we know our power – and now we must continue the fight.**

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A new Marshall Plan for the Americas
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We have to remind the world that Trump will not be president forever, that we know what’s going on, and that we’re going to fix the damage he’s done.
#

Peter, it's Ruben.
Another longer email here, but one I hope you’ll read.
I was in Germany last week for the Munich Security Conference. It’s an opportunity for us to take a step back, sit down with our strongest allies, and reorient how we’re thinking about our interests.
With Trump in the White House, I understand a bit of cynicism when it comes to diplomacy. What can we do when he’s burning everything down?
But Peter, that’s the wrong approach. Now, more than any time in our lives, we need to get out there. We have to remind the world that Trump will not be president forever, that we know what’s going on, and that we’re going to fix the damage he’s done.
A huge part of that is reconnecting with Latin America. Trump has absolutely destroyed our reputation with those nations. He’s invaded Venezuela, kidnapped Maduro, threatened Colombia, threatened Mexico, and slapped Brazil with massive tariffs because he’s friendly with former president Bolsonaro (who is serving a 27 year prison sentence for an attempted coup).
You can understand why they’d be a bit wary of us, but we have to fix that if we’re going to counterbalance Chinese influence in Latin America. America needs to reassert our influence — but for good.
That means strengthening our ties with increased trade, increased collaboration, investment, yes. But it also means building actual relationships with the people of these countries — worker visas, student visas, from workers to scientists to journalists to policymakers.
I’m talking about a new Marshall plan for Latin America. It worked after WWII in Europe because it’s a winning strategy. We can do the exact same right in our own backyard and guarantee another 100 years of collaboration, security, and prosperity.
**[Here’s an interview where I talk about all of this in more detail, alongside an op-ed I wrote on it.](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/3303?t=1&akid=4074%2E734936%2EKJ4ItT)**
I’d appreciate it if you took the time to dig into it.
Semper Fi,
Ruben

name: Virginians For Fair Elections
subject: First. Then. Now.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Virginians for Fair Elections
body:
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260219-204&t=1&akid=204%2E12592%2EHX2J_i)
**First:** Donald Trump saw the writing on the wall. MAGA Republicans are headed for losses in the midterms — so instead of changing course, Trump pushed his allies to rig as many congressional maps as possible to lock in power before voters ever cast a ballot.
**Then:** MAGA Republicans moved fast. They began redrawing maps in states like Texas and Florida, trying to squeeze out more Republican seats by manipulating district lines instead of earning votes.
**Now:** It’s Virginia’s turn to decide how we respond.
Virginians for Fair Elections is organizing to support voting YES on Virginia’s redistricting amendment — a temporary, voter-approved safeguard that protects fair elections and puts voters, not politicians, in charge. We’re working to reach voters across the Commonwealth with clear facts about what this amendment does and why it matters.
But we’re up against a well-funded effort to confuse voters and drown out the truth.
Trump and his allies don’t want Virginians informed. They want chaos, confusion, and silence. We won’t give them that.
[**If you can, help us keep fighting for free and fair elections in Virginia by donating whatever you’re able today. Protecting voting rights isn’t easy — but once those rights are eroded, it’s far harder to win them back.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260219_2.J_nwJG&amount=3&refcode=20260219-204&t=2&akid=204%2E12592%2EHX2J_i)

In 2024, we defied the odds and won an incredibly competitive race. That win didn’t come easily. Campaigns and outside groups combined spent $38 million on this toss-up seat. But thanks to this grassroots team, we rallied together to flip this seat from red to blue and deliver a historic victory for Oregon.
We brought people together from all backgrounds, connecting on the issues that matter most: reproductive rights, affordable housing, climate action, and economic opportunities that help all families thrive.
Since then, we’ve put in the work for Oregon. We’ve fought to lower costs, strengthen our education system, protect affordable healthcare, and help our communities and families thrive. _And we’re not done yet._
[**But Republicans are prepared to spend BIG to flip this seat back to red and stand in the way of delivering real progress for Oregonians. body:
This letter is about the disgusting, non-stop hate that I and the entire Somali-American community has been receiving from Donald Trump
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2095%2E791427%2EQwQHcT)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260219-1-90&t=2&akid=2095%2E791427%2EQwQHcT)
Friend, a few weeks back I wrote a letter for the _New York Times_.
The letter is about the disgusting, non-stop hate that I and the entire Somali-American community has been receiving from Donald Trump and his far-right allies over the last few months.
I’m including the entire letter below for you to read, and **[I’m respectfully asking you to chip in to my campaign today to help us fight back against Trump and continue to push our movement forward in the face of right-wing extremism.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260219-1-90&t=3&akid=2095%2E791427%2EQwQHcT) **[DONATE NOW](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260219-1-90&t=4&akid=2095%2E791427%2EQwQHcT)**
— Ilhan
* * *
**Trump Knows He’s Failing. Cue the Bigotry.**
By Ilhan Omar
On Tuesday, President Trump called my friends and me “garbage.”
This comment was only the latest in a series of remarks and Truth Social posts in which the president has demonized and spread conspiracy theories about the Somali community and about me personally. For years, the president has spewed hate speech in an effort to gin up contempt against me. He reaches for the same playbook of racism, xenophobia, Islamophobia and division again and again. At one 2019 rally, he egged on his crowd until it chanted “send her back” when he said my name.
Mr. Trump denigrates not only Somalis but so many other immigrants, too, particularly those who are Black and Muslim. While he has consistently tried to vilify newcomers, we will not let him silence us. He fails to realize how deeply Somali Americans love this country. We are doctors, teachers, police officers and elected leaders working to make our country better. Over 90 percent of Somalis living in my home state, Minnesota, are American citizens by birth or naturalization. Some even supported Mr. Trump at the ballot box.
“I don’t want them in our country,” the president said this week. “Let them go back to where they came from.”
Somali Americans remain resilient against the onslaught of attacks from the White House. But I am deeply worried about the ramifications of these tirades. When Mr. Trump maligns me, it increases the number of death threats that my family, staff members and I receive. As a member of Congress, I am privileged to have access to security when these threats arise. What keeps me up at night is that people who share the identities I hold — Black, Somali, hijabi, immigrant — will suffer the consequences of his words, which so often go unchecked by members of the Republican Party and other elected officials. All Americans have a duty to call out this hateful rhetoric when we hear it.
The president’s dehumanizing and dangerous attacks on minority immigrant communities are nothing new. When he first ran for president a decade ago, he launched his campaign with claims that he was going to pause Muslim immigration to this country. He has since falsely accused Haitian migrants of eating pets and referred to Haiti and African nations as “shithole” countries. He has accused Mexico of sending rapists and drug peddlers across our border. It is unconscionable that he fails to acknowledge how this country was built on the backs of immigrants and mocks their ongoing contributions.
While the president wastes his time attacking my community, my state, my governor and me, the promises of economic prosperity he made in his run for president last year have not come to fruition. Prices have not come down; in many cases, they have risen. His implementation of tariffs has hurt farmers and small business owners. His policies have only worsened the affordability crisis for Americans. And now, with Affordable Care Act tax credits set to expire, health care costs for American households are primed to skyrocket, and millions of people risk losing their coverage under his signature domestic policy bill.
The president knows he is failing, and so he is reverting to what he knows best: trying to divert attention by stoking bigotry.
When I was sworn into Congress in 2019, my father turned to me and expressed bewilderment that the leader of the free world was picking on a freshman member of Congress, one out of 535 members of the legislative body. The president’s goal may have been to try to tear me down, but my community and my constituents rallied behind me then, just as they are now.
I often say that although Minnesota may be cold, the people here have warm hearts. Minnesota is special. That is why when so many Somalis arrived in this country, they chose the state as home. I am deeply grateful to the people of Minnesota for the generosity, hospitality and support they have shown to every immigrant community in our state.
We will not let Mr. Trump intimidate or debilitate us. We are not afraid. After all, Minnesotans not only welcome refugees, they also sent one to Congress.

| | | | | | Hi, Peter,We logged another busy week between the legislature being in session and the campaign being in full swing! Here are the highlights:
[](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=36cb7adedb&e=8249791cac)**On Tuesday,** my staff and wife surprised me for my birthday! I got so many birthday wishes, both in person and online. I am beyond grateful to have such support from those around me. Thank you!
**On**[](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=45065be17f&e=8249791cac)**Wednesday** , I attended the Denver Candidate Forum (Here’s the Ticket, 1 of 3). I was asked a question about where I think our current Treasurer Dave Young has done a good job and where I would make changes. My short answer is that I think he’s done admirably on increasing access to the Unclaimed Property Trust Fund, and I’m looking forward to expanding his work by using my technology expertise to make it easier to return unclaimed property. I also see opportunities to tackle the way PERA is invested, moving away from our current 10% in private equity firms, to earn better, more equitable returns for our public servants. Overall, Dave has laid important groundwork for improvements, and I’m looking to implement new and innovative programs to move that progress forward. I also believe we need to bring back the property deferral tax program, buy back students loans and re-issue them at lower rates, and prioritize financial literacy education across the state.

[****](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=23b4236696&e=8249791cac)Also**on Wednesday,** I was formally endorsed by the Human Rights Campaign PAC (HRC). It means a lot to me to earn accolades for my work in the legislature protecting consumer rights, the rights of employees, and the finances of Coloradans and the state of Colorado alike. I’m excited to work with HRC throughout the coming year to forward our mutual goals.
**On Thursday** , the Colorado Film and Video Association (CFVA) hosted their annual State of the State event’s film and video industry conference to connect industry professionals and interested parties (like me!) to discuss what the future of the industry looks like. Did you know that our state’s film incentive program, which offers a tax credit of 20-22% for films that are produced here, has generated over $170 million worth of investments across 55 counties? That’s a smart investment of our state dollars, and something I sponsored and continue to support.
[](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=fc4b9bf012&e=8249791cac)**On Friday** , I sat on a panel at the _Wild West Hackin’ Fest_ , discussing weaknesses that can be found in both government and private online systems. Privacy is an important issue in the modern age and advocating for stronger privacy protocols and requirements is a component of my Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform.
**On Sunday,** I was a speaker at a Town Hall on AI and Palantir that was featured on 9 news and CBS. I have serious concerns over the role of AI in our everyday lives, from Flock cameras extending their use past limited crime work to that predatory Superbowl commercial inviting people to spy on their neighborhoods. AI offers exciting possibilities for everyone, so long as they are _properly managed and regulated_. As a tech expert with a Master’s degree in Information and Communications technology, I see the remarkable possibilities for groundbreaking research in so many different arenas - agriculture, health, archaeology, logistics, and more! - that AI holds, but its increasingly militarized use, whether on Americans or in the ongoing human rights violations in Gaza, is unconscionable and must be stopped. You can read about the event and my stance here: [https://www.cbsnews.com/colorado/news/colorado-lawmaker-advocacy-groups-artificial-intelligence-town-hall/](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=d9fc897b40&e=8249791cac)
**Upcoming Events**
Next week, I’ll be joining the Center For Free Though Equality PAC as they launch their _Secular Seven Candidate_ campaign - I am one of 7 candidates they have assembled for what they call an “A-list slate of powerhouse candidates” who champion humanist values and combat white Christian Nationalism in the halls of power. Then, I’m speaking at Wind Crest Dem Alliance on Thursday. And on Friday, I’m participating in the _What Federal Funding Changes Mean for States: Budget Working Group,_ which seeks to help state budget writers navigate a changing fiscal landscape that holds serious implications for state finances and program administration.

🚨 **Caucus & Assembly are coming — and this is where it all starts.** 🚨We are just under **two weeks** away from Caucus and Assembly, and we need your support! Make sure you help us get on the ballot by committing to Caucus for me, and make a plan for how you can attend your local precinct and county Caucus and Assembly! [https://www.coloradodems.org/caucus/schedule ](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=81833ef28e&e=8249791cac)
You can help us track our commitments and show support in numbers by filling out this short Commit to Caucus pledge [https://www.briannaforco.com/caucus](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=aa25d32ce1&e=8249791cac).Caucus is one of the most important moments in our democracy, and every year turnout is way too low. That means the people who _do_ show up get an outsized say in where our party goes next. Showing up to caucus is the difference between feeling “meh” about the Democrats on your June primary ballot... and being genuinely excited to vote blue in November.Here’s the real talk: **if we don’t show up strong at Caucus and Assembly, our campaign ends there.** We’re building momentum and commitments every day, but our goal isn’t just to attend...it’s to be loud, organized, and visible.Caucus is active participation - you dedicate an evening to democracy! You show up. You meet your neighbors. You help decide the future of the party. And honestly? That’s what campaigns should be about. Building community, not just collecting votes or checks.🗳️ **Commit to caucus and assembly March 3–7
** 👉 Pledge here:[ https://www.briannaforco.com/caucus](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=ac3f59eac1&e=8249791cac)In just a couple hours on one night, **you can have a massive impact on our democracy.** Don’t wait until the primary! This is where your voice truly counts.

subject: Get in your RSVP – See you Tuesday, Feb. 24th in Dallas! 🎟️ 🎟️ 🎟️
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
NEXT WEEK IN DALLAS: TOP's Black History Month Symposium with Michael Harriot!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Black%20AF%20-%20Updated%20graphic.jpg]
THIS COMING TUESDAY: TOP is excited to have Michael Harriot [https://www.michaelharriot.com/] , best-selling author of Black AF History [https://www.michaelharriot.com/poscasts] , join us for an evening of connection, celebration, and building community power!
This event honoring the 100th anniversary of Black History Month and will be held next week, February 24th at 6:30 p.m. at Friendship-West Baptist Church in Dallas , so mark your calendars and RSVP today. An RSVP is required to attend this event! [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/ [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
EARLY VOTE IN TEXAS:
Head to the polls and have your voice heard
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20PAC%20canvass%20with%20Adrian%20Reyna.jpg]
Don't wait: GO VOTE in the Texas Democratic Primary! Early voting started this Tuesday and goes through February 27. Election Day is Tuesday, March 3.
This is OUR chance to vote for candidates who will defend our communities, champion policies that lift up our families, and who will take the fight to MAGA. Our TOP PAC canvass crew has been out in the community, knocking on doors and engaging with voters on what makes this election so critical.
CHECK OUT TOP PAC's full list of endorsed candidates for this primary election. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
Make a plan to cast your ballot, and tell your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same!
VOTE FOR US:
Help TOP host a panel at this year's Netroots Nation conference
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NN20th.png]
TOP applied to host a panel at Netroots Nation this year, and we'd love your VOTE to make this panel a reality. It'll take you less than a minute to show your support, and it'll get us closer to sharing TOP's theory of change on the national stage with hundreds of progressive activists and organizers from across the country.
Just follow these quick steps:
1. Check out our panel topic, "Texas: MAGA before MAGA and how we can still win!" [https://netrootsnation.secure-platform.com/nn26/gallery/rounds/82014/details/12779]
2. Click on the blue "Vote for this submission" button.
3. Create a new account if you need to, or log in to your existing Netroots account.
4. Select our panel and vote!
Feel free to share the panel link on your social media, and use the hashtag #NN26 .
Honoring a lifelong fighter for justice and driver for societal change
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rev.%20Jesse%20Jackson.jpg]
Our country and movement lost a dynamic, powerful voice for justice this week. TOP joins millions of others in honoring the life of Rev. Jesse Jackson, a change-maker whose impact has spanned decades. Rev. Jackson's actions and words challenged oppressive power structures not only in the U.S., but across the world.
A protégé of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. who marched alongside him in Selma, Jackson's founding of the Rainbow PUSH Coalition helped reimagine what's politically viable in our country, by promoting a vision rooted in racial and economic justice. May his legacy continue to inspire and move future generations to fight for the common good. Rest in power, Rev. Jackson.
TRUMP TRACKER:
He's eroding our privacy and building a digital watchtower
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20surveillance.png]
Remember the mess that was DOGE? While it's (thankfully) no longer around in its official capacity, the private data of millions of people is now less secure because of its careless crusade. With Trump 2.0, the public has been subject to intensified surveillance.
Not just that, AI tools are being weaponized against us, to monitor our actions in disturbingly intricate ways, even going so far as to target people based on ideology. ( Palantir has become a household name for a reason. [https://www.npr.org/2025/05/01/nx-s1-5372776/palantir-tech-contracts-trump] )
Political irony aside, this is what "Big Government" looks like — and it's working against the people.
Read up on how Trump and MAGA are working to consolidate power through using our own personal data against us. [https://www.americanprogress.org/article/the-trump-administration-is-using-americans-sensitive-data-to-build-a-digital-watchtower/]
Español
LA PRÓXIMA SEMANA EN DALLAS:
Se acerca el Simposio del Mes de la Historia Negra de TOP con Michael Harriot
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Black%20AF%20-%20Updated%20graphic.jpg]
ESTE MARTES: TOP se complace en contar con la presencia de Michael Harriot, autor del libro mejor vendido "Black AF History," para una noche de conexión, celebración y fortalecimiento comunitario.
Este evento, que conmemora el centenario del Mes de la Historia Negra, se celebrará la próxima semana, 24 de febrero, as las 6:30 p.m. en la Iglesia Bautista Friendship-West de Dallas. ¡Se requiere confirmación de asistencia para asistir! [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/ [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
VOTACIÓN ANTICIPADA EN TEXAS:
Vaya a las urnas y haga escuchar su voz
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20PAC%20canvass%20with%20Adrian%20Reyna.jpg]
¡No espere más: SALGA A VOTAR en la Primaria Demócrata de Texas! La votación anticipada comenzó este martes y continúa hasta el 27 de febrero. El Día de la Elección es el martes 3 de marzo.
Esta es NUESTRA oportunidad de votar por candidatas y candidatos que defenderán a nuestras comunidades, impulsarán políticas que fortalezcan a nuestras familias y que enfrentarán la agenda de MAGA. Nuestro equipo de TOP PAC ha estado en la comunidad, tocando puertas y conversando con votantes sobre por qué esta elección es tan importante.
CONSULTA la lista completa de candidatos respaldados por TOP PAC para estas primarias. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
¡Planifica tu voto y dile a tus amigos, familiares y vecinos que hagan lo mismo!
VOTA POR NOSOTROS: Ayuda a TOP a organizar un panel en la conferencia Netroots Nation de este año
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NN20th.png]
TOP solicitó organizar un panel en Netroots Nation este año, y nos encantaría contar con su VOTO para hacerlo realidad. Le tomará menos de un minuto mostrar su apoyo , y nos ayudará a acercarnos a compartir la teoría de cambio de TOP en el escenario nacional con cientos de activistas y organizadores progresistas de todo el país.
Solo sigue estos pasos:
1. Consulta el tema de nuestro panel: "Texas: ¡MAGA antes de MAGA y cómo aún podemos ganar!" [https://netrootsnation.secure-platform.com/nn26/gallery/rounds/82014/details/12779]
2. Haz clic en el botón azul "Vota por esta propuesta."
3. Crea una cuenta nueva si lo necesitas o inicia sesión en tu cuenta de Netroots.
4. ¡Selecciona nuestro panel y vota!
Comparte el enlace del panel en tus redes sociales y usa la etiqueta #NN26 .
Homenaje a un luchador de toda la vida por la justicia y un impulsor del cambio social
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rev.%20Jesse%20Jackson.jpg]
Nuestro país y nuestro movimiento perdieron esta semana una voz dinámica y poderosa a favor de la justicia. TOP se une a millones de personas para honrar la vida del reverendo Jesse Jackson, un creador de cambios cuyo impacto se ha extendido por décadas. Las acciones y palabras del reverendo Jackson desafiaron las estructuras de poder opresivas no solo en Estados Unidos, sino en todo el mundo.
Protegido del Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., quien marchó junto a él en Selma, la fundación de la Coalición Rainbow PUSH por parte de Jackson ayudó a reimaginar lo que es políticamente viable en nuestro país, al promover una visión arraigada en la justicia racial y económica. Que su legado siga inspirando e impulsando a las futuras generaciones a luchar por el bien común. Descanse en paz, reverendo Jackson.
RASTREADOR DE TRUMP: Está erosionando nuestra privacidad y construyendo una torre de vigilancia digital
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20surveillance.png]
¿Recuerdan el desastre que fue DOGE? Aunque (por suerte) ya no existe oficialmente, los datos privados de millones de personas ahora están menos seguros debido a su campaña irresponsable. Con Trump 2.0, el público ha sido sometido a una vigilancia intensificada.
No solo eso, las herramientas de IA se están utilizando como armas contra nosotros para monitorear nuestras acciones de maneras inquietantemente complejas, llegando incluso a atacar a personas según su ideología. ( Palantir se ha convertido en un nombre conocido por algo. [https://www.npr.org/2025/05/01/nx-s1-5372776/palantir-tech-contracts-trump] )
Dejando de lado la ironía política, así es como se ve el "Gran Gobierno", y está trabajando en contra del pueblo.
Lean cómo Trump y MAGA están trabajando para consolidar su poder usando nuestros propios datos personales en nuestra contra. [https://www.americanprogress.org/article/the-trump-administration-is-using-americans-sensitive-data-to-build-a-digital-watchtower/]

Nuestro equipo de TOP PAC ha estado en la comunidad, tocando puertas y conversando con votantes sobre por qué esta elección es tan importante. CONSULTA la lista completa de candidatos respaldados por TOP PAC para estas primarias. [] ¡Planifica tu voto y dile a tus amigos, familiares y vecinos que hagan lo mismo! VOTA POR NOSOTROS: Ayuda a TOP a organizar un panel en la conferencia Netroots Nation de este año [] TOP solicitó organizar un panel en Netroots Nation este año, y nos encantaría contar con su VOTO para hacerlo realidad. Le tomará menos de un minuto mostrar su apoyo , y nos ayudará a acercarnos a compartir la teoría de cambio de TOP en el escenario nacional con cientos de activistas y organizadores progresistas de todo el país. Solo sigue estos pasos: 1. Consulta el tema de nuestro panel: "Texas: ¡MAGA antes de MAGA y cómo aún podemos ganar!" [] 2. Haz clic en el botón azul "Vota por esta propuesta." 3. Crea una cuenta nueva si lo necesitas o inicia sesión en tu cuenta de Netroots. 4. ¡Selecciona nuestro panel y vota! Comparte el enlace del panel en tus redes sociales y usa la etiqueta #NN26 . Homenaje a un luchador de toda la vida por la justicia y un impulsor del cambio social [] Nuestro país y nuestro movimiento perdieron esta semana una voz dinámica y poderosa a favor de la justicia. TOP se une a millones de personas para honrar la vida del reverendo Jesse Jackson, un creador de cambios cuyo impacto se ha extendido por décadas. Las acciones y palabras del reverendo Jackson desafiaron las estructuras de poder opresivas no solo en Estados Unidos, sino en todo el mundo. Protegido del Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., quien marchó junto a él en Selma, la fundación de la Coalición Rainbow PUSH por parte de Jackson ayudó a reimaginar lo que es políticamente viable en nuestro país, al promover una visión arraigada en la justicia racial y económica. Que su legado siga inspirando e impulsando a las futuras generaciones a luchar por el bien común. Descanse en paz, reverendo Jackson. RASTREADOR DE TRUMP: Está erosionando nuestra privacidad y construyendo una torre de vigilancia digital [] ¿Recuerdan el desastre que fue DOGE? Aunque (por suerte) ya no existe oficialmente, los datos privados de millones de personas ahora están menos seguros debido a su campaña irresponsable. Con Trump 2.0, el público ha sido sometido a una vigilancia intensificada. No solo eso, las herramientas de IA se están utilizando como armas contra nosotros para monitorear nuestras acciones de maneras inquietantemente complejas, llegando incluso a atacar a personas según su ideología. ( Palantir se ha convertido en un nombre conocido por algo. [] ) Dejando de lado la ironía política, así es como se ve el "Gran Gobierno", y está trabajando en contra del pueblo. Lean cómo Trump y MAGA están trabajando para consolidar su poder usando nuestros propios datos personales en nuestra contra. [] Copyright (C) 2026 Texas Organizing Project. All rights reserved. Have you ever wondered what the world’s wealthiest people think about day to day? Allow us to fill you in! | | | Peter, Have you ever wondered what the world’s wealthiest people think about day to day? Allow us to fill you in! **NOW PRESENTING:
The List of Things Billionaires Care About:**
* Themselves

**ALSO PRESENTING:
The List of Things Billionaires Don’t Care About**
* You
* Your family
* Your community
* Treating working people with respect
* Our planet and its natural resources
* Elections being decided by the voters, not dark money
* Whether people have money to feed and house their families
* Paying their fair share in taxes
* Making any kind of positive contribution to society

We’re sick and tired of self-serving billionaires deciding how our country is run. **That’s why the Working Families Party fights every day for working people, to build a government that gives a damn about us.[If you’re with us, can you pitch in $10 or whatever you can afford to keep the work going?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T94MpEBcgQ2Zxi0GXSkSZMhlBxVzGFFrdAVSOGjHiiiJYTmLexhAdyrMkSUb9AEpoz0Gpt7DNc_MODoH6Qp5iSHgP8VmrU5Wt0zEZh-JfKAMbCwQMiIOOvoPHXMjBjWLKVdZyK8jArehbc622-htzc84ZzQ4pDjmN9sDWymTG31vYftSvORR4RnmaRoK1bOJVJet1pQkicz_xoWLdykk52BDXLauyqgLBCXvGbhK2CSE2VnKR1uACS1hDiBWIHUpeUhuwynmOJvnoOcfCiiBTZoIIsndEkFMq93urY_CQN7lurhSTyXcZ5a9NY1aroxXHD1-eh_UjyRStHjRm24IjRPg/4oa/e2AHiBqgT2yT1ITA196jRQ/h0/h001.BpRFMP9r1VSruEhX_8zl9mF5Kotk_O1XQlw0AO7oM0Y)** **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T94MpEBcgQ2Zxi0GXSkSZMhlBxVzGFFrdAVSOGjHiiiJYTmLexhAdyrMkSUb9AEpozly2MTTUc3K-ZNCJkS8X2VnHdXkmKb7hWArbFR7lXRf5v0VTReSbx54gD9qCkMOBQAo9OL0xn_0pCumBDDQEErtQUasiNxZ2Ksctvqp4ksQF6Upf5Kn8ShrmLFGhHHIxzpH5ZNtjRX6cVKmgjxvhZIV4toRt4m1FFrjR_WnOCuXsw0aoyWpmtAsmWtJShcqOt7X0--BOWsTJHTvZTfXxFwVyz19No0g33YWXd1WXgM7ZYgmdEQkTeSoB1ADAyDPp9d06iD2CiuZ3IlwLM9yvWTWadc17wtMflWQFl0bGVR5k/4oa/e2AHiBqgT2yT1ITA196jRQ/h1/h001.SGrmQHVGzVx238ac0KDfQxlUVtJjpVRSRG9ElC8p5Hc)** People don’t become billionaires by working hard and catching a lucky break, Peter. Compared to the median American household, those donations are equivalent to $107.32. For his _entire life._ To add insult to injury, Elon Musk spent half that amount to buy the 2024 election for Donald Trump — just one in a long line of billionaires electing despicable candidates in exchange for bigger tax cuts. **While we work to get big money out of politics, Elon Musk and his far-right buddies are going to keep trying to buy our elections. * Hire organizers and staff that can get our champions over the finish line,
* Share important messages with voters on social media, TV, the radio, and in their mailboxes — as well as counter smears and attack ads,
* And so much more.

clean_body: Have you ever wondered what the world’s wealthiest people think about day to day? Allow us to fill you in! | | | Peter, Have you ever wondered what the world’s wealthiest people think about day to day? Allow us to fill you in! NOW PRESENTING: The List of Things Billionaires Care About: Themselves ALSO PRESENTING: The List of Things Billionaires Don’t Care About You Your family Your community Treating working people with respect Our planet and its natural resources Elections being decided by the voters, not dark money Whether people have money to feed and house their families Paying their fair share in taxes Making any kind of positive contribution to society We’re sick and tired of self-serving billionaires deciding how our country is run. That’s why the Working Families Party fights every day for working people, to build a government that gives a damn about us. People don’t become billionaires by working hard and catching a lucky break, Peter. Instead, they squeeze dry customers, employees, and governments to amass an amount of money they couldn’t spend in a hundred lifetimes. Even when they donate to charity, what they give is often laughable compared to what they keep: Forbes 1 recently estimated Elon Musk’s lifetime giving at $0.5 billion. Compared to the median American household, those donations are equivalent to $107.32. For his entire life. To add insult to injury, Elon Musk spent half that amount to buy the 2024 election for Donald Trump — just one in a long line of billionaires electing despicable candidates in exchange for bigger tax cuts. While we work to get big money out of politics, Elon Musk and his far-right buddies are going to keep trying to buy our elections. But the good news is that the Working Families Party and our allies are going to keep beating them. We’ve seen firsthand that WFP members like you can defeat billionaire spending in crucial elections. Last year, we humiliated Elon Musk by trouncing him in the Wisconsin Supreme Court races, Jeffrey Yass by defending all three Pennsylvania Supreme Court races up for election, and a coalition of billionaire donors by electing WFP champion Zohran Mamdani to lead New York City despite their best efforts. When we throw down to share our message with voters and get them to the polls, we can win. But unlike our ultra-wealthy opponents, we don’t have endless resources to work with. Instead, we rely on the generosity of people like you, Peter, to help us: Recruit and train leaders who will fight for our values in office, Hire organizers and staff that can get our champions over the finish line, Share important messages with voters on social media, TV, the radio, and in their mailboxes — as well as counter smears and attack ads, And so much more.
